goal: rust/ is a Cargo project whose `cargo build --release --locked` and `cargo test --release --locked` pass; started with DATABASE_URL (a PostgreSQL database with schema.sql loaded, unchanged) and PORT, its binary serves /rest/users, /rest/groups, /rest/roles, /rest/layers, /rest/layerdatasources and /rest/layerappearances with the same HTTP Basic login, permissions, status codes, JSON, field restriction (output:only), filters and database writes as the original Java reference app in reference/reference-app, without any Java involved.
final_message:
I'm making no further changes. The goal can't be fully met because the original itself is inconsistent. In 2 of the 36 group-permission setups I tested, the original answers the same group request, on the same data, with 200 on some calls and 500 on others. No other implementation can match both answers either.

The port in `rust/` matches the original on every other request I compared, about 5,000 in total. `cargo build --release --locked` and `cargo test --release --locked` both pass.

Run `/goal clear` to end the loop.

```
# shogun-rest

A Rust re-implementation of a slice of the SHOGun-Core (5.3.x) REST API:
`/rest/users`, `/rest/groups`, `/rest/roles`, `/rest/layers`,
`/rest/layerdatasources` and `/rest/layerappearances` (list, `output:only`,
`/filter`, get, create, partial update, delete, plus
`/rest/users/{id}/userGroups` and `/rest/groups/{id}/users`), running on the
unchanged database schema of the original (`../schema.sql`).

```
cargo build --release --locked
DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db PORT=8080 ./target/release/shogun-rest
```

## Layout

| file | role |
|---|---|
| `src/main.rs` | HTTP server, Spring Security filter chain (firewall, Basic auth, JSESSIONID session, 401/403), routing |
| `src/api.rs` | the `AbstractRestController` endpoints, `output:only` / filter handling, content negotiation |
| `src/security.rs` | authentication against `users` (bcrypt), role hierarchy, the entity permission evaluators |
| `src/model.rs` | entity classes: JSON properties, tables/columns, collections, cascades, constructor defaults |
| `src/jackson.rs` | JSON -> entity with Jackson 2.14's coercion rules and `readerForUpdating` semantics |
| `src/ser.rs` | entity -> JSON |
| `src/store.rs` | Hibernate-like loading, saving (table id generator, cascades, collections), deleting, queries |
| `src/javaish.rs` | Java/Spring/Commons details (Double.toString, Locale, BeanUtils conversion, HashMap order, serialization) |

## Behaviour of the original that is reproduced on purpose

* POST of a data source and any non-null `source` of a layer is refused (abstract type).
* Non-admins can never create (CREATE is evaluated on a fresh instance).
* Ids come from `hibernate_sequences` in a separate transaction: an id stays
  consumed when the insert fails later.
* Nested cascaded objects (`appearance`, `tileGrid`, `tileGridExtent`) with an
  id overwrite that row completely (and drop its permission rows); without an id
  they are inserted. Same-session duplicates fail.
* Set elements read from JSON are deduplicated by Java `equals` (which ignores ids).
* A failed partial update still commits the properties applied before the
  failing one (checked Jackson exception), unless a user-group reference failed
  in the id resolver (transaction marked rollback-only).
* `output:only` builds new beans: non-admins only see roles and appearances,
  data sources answer 500 (abstract class).
* The original's "collection was evicted" failure on group lists/filters.
* XYZ `resolutions` are `Point2D.Double` values stored Java-serialized.

## Tests

`cargo test` runs unit tests and `tests/api.rs`, an end-to-end test that starts
the binary with `DATABASE_URL`/`PORT`, loads `tests/data/seed.sql` and checks
the API. On an empty database it uses that database and empties it again; on a
database holding data it creates a temporary database on the same server
(schema from `tests/data/schema.sql`) and drops it afterwards.

`tests/tools/compare.py` is the differential harness used during development:
it resets two databases to the same data (`tests/data/seed.sql` or
`tests/data/demo.sql`), replays requests against the original and this service
and compares status codes, JSON and all written rows.
```

//! The REST endpoints of `AbstractRestController` (+ the two user/group
//! sub-resources) for the six resources of the slice.

use crate::jackson::{apply_object, apply_object_tracked, collect_group_ids, json_as_int, parse_body, GroupRes, ReadCtx};
use crate::javaish::{beanutils_bool, beanutils_double, beanutils_int, spring_param_order, spring_parse_int, split_comma};
use crate::model::{Class, Obj, SimpleType, V};
use crate::security::{Evaluator, Perm};
use crate::ser;
use crate::store::{self, BagContext, Filter, Loader, Param, Planner, SaveMode};
use deadpool_postgres::Pool;
use serde_json::Value;
use std::collections::HashSet;

pub enum Reply {
    Json(u16, Value),
    /// status without body (ResponseEntity without entity)
    Empty(u16),
    /// container generated error page
    Error(u16),
    /// 200 answer to OPTIONS
    Allow(&'static str),
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Resource {
    Users,
    Groups,
    Roles,
    Layers,
    LayerDataSources,
    LayerAppearances,
}

impl Resource {
    pub fn from_segment(s: &str) -> Option<Resource> {
        Some(match s {
            "users" => Resource::Users,
            "groups" => Resource::Groups,
            "roles" => Resource::Roles,
            "layers" => Resource::Layers,
            "layerdatasources" => Resource::LayerDataSources,
            "layerappearances" => Resource::LayerAppearances,
            _ => return None,
        })
    }

    /// Entity class of the controller (for data sources: the abstract base,
    /// represented by any subclass; only the shared fields are used).
    fn class(self) -> Class {
        match self {
            Resource::Users => Class::User,
            Resource::Groups => Class::UserGroup,
            Resource::Roles => Class::Role,
            Resource::Layers => Class::Layer,
            Resource::LayerDataSources => Class::ImageWms,
            Resource::LayerAppearances => Class::LayerAppearance,
        }
    }

    fn is_lds(self) -> bool {
        self == Resource::LayerDataSources
    }
}

fn java_eq_ignore_case(a: &str, b: &str) -> bool {
    let ac: Vec<char> = a.chars().collect();
    let bc: Vec<char> = b.chars().collect();
    if ac.len() != bc.len() {
        return false;
    }
    ac.iter().zip(bc.iter()).all(|(x, y)| {
        if x == y {
            return true;
        }
        let ux: Vec<char> = x.to_uppercase().collect();
        let uy: Vec<char> = y.to_uppercase().collect();
        if ux == uy {
            return true;
        }
        let lx: Vec<char> = ux.iter().flat_map(|c| c.to_lowercase()).collect();
        let ly: Vec<char> = uy.iter().flat_map(|c| c.to_lowercase()).collect();
        lx == ly
    })
}

/// Fields of `EntityUtil.getFilterableOrRestrictableFieldNames` with type
/// and qualified column (subclass fields first, `id` last).
fn simple_fields(res: Resource) -> Vec<(&'static str, SimpleType, String)> {
    let class = res.class();
    let fields: Vec<(&'static str, SimpleType, Option<(&'static str, &'static str)>)> = if res.is_lds() {
        // only the fields declared on LayerDataSource (+ id)
        class.simple_fields().into_iter().filter(|f| f.2.map(|t| t.0 == "layerdatasources").unwrap_or(false)).collect()
    } else {
        class.simple_fields()
    };
    // group by declaring table, deepest class first
    let tables = class.tables();
    let mut out = vec![];
    for t in tables.iter().rev() {
        for f in &fields {
            if let Some((ft, col)) = f.2 {
                if ft == *t {
                    out.push((f.0, f.1, format!("{}.{}", ft, col)));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let (_, root) = store::resource_from(class);
    out.push(("id", SimpleType::Int, format!("{}.id", root)));
    out
}

/// `EntityUtil.determineRestrictFields`
fn restrict_fields(res: Resource, params: &[(String, Vec<String>)]) -> Option<Vec<(&'static str, SimpleType, String)>> {
    let mut requested: Option<Vec<String>> = None;
    for (k, vals) in params {
        if java_eq_ignore_case("output:only", k) {
            let mut out = vec![];
            for v in vals {
                out.extend(split_comma(v));
            }
            requested = if out.is_empty() { None } else { Some(out) };
        }
    }
    let requested = requested?;
    let mut out = vec![];
    for f in simple_fields(res) {
        for r in &requested {
            if java_eq_ignore_case(f.0, r) && !out.iter().any(|o: &(&str, SimpleType, String)| o.0 == f.0) {
                out.push(f.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(out)
    }
}

fn cast(ty: SimpleType, s: &str) -> Param {
    match ty {
        SimpleType::Str => Param::Str(s.to_string()),
        SimpleType::Int => Param::Int(beanutils_int(s)),
        SimpleType::Bool => Param::Bool(beanutils_bool(s)),
        SimpleType::Dbl => Param::Dbl(beanutils_double(s)),
    }
}

pub struct Ctx<'a> {
    pub pool: &'a Pool,
    pub ev: &'a Evaluator,
}

macro_rules! db {
    ($e:expr, $err:expr) => {
        match $e {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(e) => {
                tracing_log(&e);
                return $err;
            }
        }
    };
}

pub fn tracing_log(e: &str) {
    if std::env::var("SHOGUN_DEBUG").is_ok() {
        eprintln!("error: {}", e);
    }
}

/// filters loaded entities by READ permission (`@PostFilter`)
fn readable(ev: &Evaluator, objs: Vec<Obj>) -> Vec<Obj> {
    objs.into_iter().filter(|o| ev.allowed(o.class, o.id, Perm::Read)).collect()
}

async fn list_or_filter(ctx: &Ctx<'_>, res: Resource, params: &[(String, Vec<String>)], filter_mode: bool) -> Reply {
    let restrict = restrict_fields(res, params);
    let mut filter: Filter = vec![];
    if filter_mode {
        let keys: Vec<&(String, Vec<String>)> = params.iter().filter(|(k, _)| k != "output:only").collect();
        for f in simple_fields(res) {
            if let Some((_, vals)) = keys.iter().find(|(k, _)| java_eq_ignore_case(f.0, k)) {
                filter.push((f.2.clone(), vals.iter().map(|v| cast(f.1, v)).collect()));
            }
        }
        if filter.is_empty() {
            return Reply::Json(200, Value::Array(vec![]));
        }
    }
    let client = db!(ctx.pool.get().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), Reply::Error(500));
    let class = res.class();
    if let Some(props) = restrict {
        let beans = db!(store::query_restricted(&**client, class, &props, &filter).await, Reply::Error(500));
        if res.is_lds() && !beans.is_empty() {
            // Transformers.aliasToBean(LayerDataSource.class) cannot instantiate the abstract class
            return Reply::Error(500);
        }
        let beans: Vec<Obj> = if ctx.ev.admin {
            beans
        } else {
            // the beans carry no permissions and are new instances: only the
            // "always readable" types pass the READ check
            match class {
                Class::Role | Class::LayerAppearance => beans,
                _ => vec![],
            }
        };
        return Reply::Json(200, ser::list(&beans));
    }
    if class == Class::UserGroup && db!(store::group_criteria_fails(&**client, &filter).await, Reply::Error(500)) {
        return Reply::Error(500);
    }
    let ids = db!(store::query_ids(&**client, class, &filter).await, Reply::Error(500));
    let mut loader = Loader::new(&**client);
    let mut objs = vec![];
    for id in &ids {
        if let Some(o) = db!(loader.load_resource(class, *id).await, Reply::Error(500)) {
            objs.push(o);
        }
    }
    let bag_ctx = match res {
        Resource::Layers => Some(BagContext::LayerCriteria),
        Resource::LayerDataSources => Some(BagContext::LdsCriteria),
        _ => None,
    };
    if let Some(bc) = bag_ctx {
        let bags = db!(store::wmts_url_bags(&**client, bc, &ids).await, Reply::Error(500));
        objs.iter_mut().for_each(|o| store::apply_url_bags(o, &bags));
    }
    Reply::Json(200, ser::list(&readable(ctx.ev, objs)))
}

async fn find_by_id(ctx: &Ctx<'_>, res: Resource, id: i32) -> Reply {
    let client = db!(ctx.pool.get().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), Reply::Error(500));
    let mut loader = Loader::new(&**client);
    match db!(loader.load_resource(res.class(), id).await, Reply::Empty(404)) {
        Some(mut o) if ctx.ev.allowed(o.class, o.id, Perm::Read) => {
            db!(apply_get_bags(&**client, res, &mut o).await, Reply::Error(500));
            Reply::Json(200, ser::obj(&o))
        }
        _ => Reply::Empty(404),
    }
}

/// url bags of WMTS sources as `session.get` of the resource loads them
async fn apply_get_bags<C: tokio_postgres::GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, res: Resource, o: &mut Obj) -> Result<(), String> {
    let bc = match res {
        Resource::Layers => BagContext::LayerGet,
        Resource::LayerDataSources => BagContext::LdsGet,
        _ => return Ok(()),
    };
    let id = match o.id {
        Some(i) => i,
        None => return Ok(()),
    };
    let bags = store::wmts_url_bags(c, bc, &[id]).await?;
    store::apply_url_bags(o, &bags);
    Ok(())
}

/// Resolves the user group ids of a document like the original's id
/// resolver (`loadById` with READ check) would.
async fn read_ctx<C: tokio_postgres::GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, ev: &Evaluator, doc: &Value) -> Result<ReadCtx, String> {
    let mut ids = vec![];
    collect_group_ids(doc, &mut ids);
    let mut rc = ReadCtx { admin: ev.admin, ..Default::default() };
    for gid in ids {
        if rc.groups.contains_key(&gid) {
            continue;
        }
        let r = if !store::group_exists(c, gid).await? {
            GroupRes::Missing
        } else if !ev.allowed(Class::UserGroup, Some(gid), Perm::Read) {
            GroupRes::Denied
        } else {
            GroupRes::Ok
        };
        rc.groups.insert(gid, r);
    }
    Ok(rc)
}

async fn create(ctx: &Ctx<'_>, res: Resource, body: &str) -> Reply {
    const FAIL: Reply = Reply::Empty(400);
    let v = match parse_body(body) {
        Ok(Some(v)) => v,
        _ => return FAIL,
    };
    if res.is_lds() {
        // Jackson cannot construct the abstract LayerDataSource
        return FAIL;
    }
    let m = match v.as_object() {
        Some(m) => m,
        None => return FAIL,
    };
    let mut client = db!(ctx.pool.get().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), Reply::Error(500));
    let mut obj = Obj::new(res.class());
    let mut rc = db!(read_ctx(&**client, ctx.ev, &v).await, FAIL);
    if let Err(e) = apply_object(&mut obj, m, &mut rc) {
        tracing_log(&e);
        return FAIL;
    }
    if obj.id.is_some() {
        return FAIL;
    }
    // CREATE is never granted on a new instance to non-admins
    if !ctx.ev.allowed(obj.class, None, Perm::Create) {
        return FAIL;
    }
    let plan = {
        let mut planner = Planner::new(&**client, HashSet::new());
        db!(planner.plan(&mut obj, SaveMode::Insert, None).await, FAIL)
    };
    let now = chrono::Local::now().naive_local();
    let tx = db!(client.transaction().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), FAIL);
    db!(plan.execute(&*tx, now).await, FAIL);
    db!(tx.commit().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), FAIL);
    Reply::Json(201, ser::obj(&obj))
}

async fn update(ctx: &Ctx<'_>, res: Resource, id: i32, body: &str) -> Reply {
    const NOT_FOUND: Reply = Reply::Empty(404);
    let v = match parse_body(body) {
        Err(_) => return NOT_FOUND,
        Ok(None) => return Reply::Empty(400),
        Ok(Some(v)) => v,
    };
    let m = match v.as_object() {
        Some(m) if m.contains_key("id") => m.clone(),
        _ => return Reply::Empty(400),
    };
    if json_as_int(&m["id"]) != id {
        return Reply::Empty(400);
    }
    let mut client = db!(ctx.pool.get().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), Reply::Error(500));
    let (mut obj, session) = {
        let mut loader = Loader::new(&**client);
        let o = db!(loader.load_resource(res.class(), id).await, NOT_FOUND);
        match o {
            Some(mut o) => {
                db!(apply_get_bags(&**client, res, &mut o).await, NOT_FOUND);
                (o, loader.loaded())
            }
            None => return NOT_FOUND,
        }
    };
    if !ctx.ev.allowed(obj.class, obj.id, Perm::Read) || !ctx.ev.allowed(obj.class, obj.id, Perm::Update) {
        return NOT_FOUND;
    }
    let mut rc = db!(read_ctx(&**client, ctx.ev, &v).await, NOT_FOUND);
    let mut applied = vec![];
    let read = apply_object_tracked(&mut obj, &m, &mut rc, &mut applied);
    if let Err(e) = &read {
        tracing_log(e);
        if rc.rollback_only {
            return NOT_FOUND;
        }
        // Jackson's (checked) exception does not roll back the service's
        // transaction: what was applied so far is flushed on commit.
    }
    if obj.id != Some(id) {
        return NOT_FOUND;
    }
    let touched: HashSet<&'static str> = applied.into_iter().collect();
    let plan = {
        let mut planner = Planner::new(&**client, session);
        db!(planner.plan(&mut obj, SaveMode::Persistent, Some(touched)).await, NOT_FOUND)
    };
    let now = chrono::Local::now().naive_local();
    let tx = db!(client.transaction().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), NOT_FOUND);
    db!(plan.execute(&*tx, now).await, NOT_FOUND);
    db!(tx.commit().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), NOT_FOUND);
    if read.is_err() {
        return NOT_FOUND;
    }
    Reply::Json(200, ser::obj(&obj))
}

async fn delete(ctx: &Ctx<'_>, res: Resource, id: i32) -> Reply {
    const NOT_FOUND: Reply = Reply::Empty(404);
    let mut client = db!(ctx.pool.get().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), Reply::Error(500));
    let obj = {
        let mut loader = Loader::new(&**client);
        match db!(loader.load_resource(res.class(), id).await, NOT_FOUND) {
            Some(o) => o,
            None => return NOT_FOUND,
        }
    };
    if !ctx.ev.allowed(obj.class, obj.id, Perm::Read) || !ctx.ev.allowed(obj.class, obj.id, Perm::Delete) {
        return NOT_FOUND;
    }
    let tx = db!(client.transaction().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), NOT_FOUND);
    if obj.class == Class::Layer {
        let maps = db!(store::maps_with_layer(&*tx, id).await, NOT_FOUND);
        for map in maps {
            if !ctx.ev.allowed_generic(map, Perm::Update) {
                return NOT_FOUND;
            }
            db!(store::remove_layer_from_map(&*tx, map, id).await, NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }
    db!(store::delete_entity(&*tx, &obj).await, NOT_FOUND);
    db!(tx.commit().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), NOT_FOUND);
    Reply::Empty(204)
}

async fn groups_of_user(ctx: &Ctx<'_>, id: i32) -> Reply {
    let client = db!(ctx.pool.get().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string()), Reply::Error(500));
    let mut loader = Loader::new(&**client);
    let user = match db!(loader.load(Class::User, id).await, Reply::Empty(404)) {
        Some(u) => u,
        None => return Reply::Empty(404),
    };
    let mut groups = vec![];

async fn users_of_group(ctx: &Ctx<'_>, id: i32) -> Reply {

/// Content negotiation against `application/json` (Spring `MediaType`
/// compatibility). `None` = the Accept header cannot be parsed.
fn accepts_json(accept: Option<&str>, plus_json: bool) -> Option<bool> {
    let h = match accept {
        None => return Some(true),
        Some(h) if h.trim().is_empty() => return Some(true),
        Some(h) => h,
    };
    let mut any = false;
    for part in h.split(',') {
        let part = part.trim();
        if part.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let mt = part.split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
        let (t, st) = mt.split_once('/')?;
        if t.is_empty() || st.is_empty() || t.contains(char::is_whitespace) || st.contains(char::is_whitespace) || st.contains('/') {
            return None;
        }
        if t == "*" && st != "*" {
            return None;
        }
        let ok = (t == "*")
            || (t == "application"
                && (st == "*" || st == "json" || (st.starts_with("*+") && &st[2..] == "json") || (plus_json && st.ends_with("+json"))));
        any |= ok;
    }
    Some(any)
}

/// Dispatches a request below `/rest/{resource}`; `rest` are the remaining
/// (decoded) path segments.
pub async fn dispatch(
    ctx: &Ctx<'_>,
    res: Resource,
    method: &str,
    rest: &[String],
    query: Vec<(String, String)>,
    body: &str,
    accept: Option<&str>,
) -> Reply {
    // handlers declared with produces = "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
    let produces_json = match (rest.len(), method) {
        (0, "GET" | "HEAD" | "POST") => true,
        (1, "GET" | "HEAD" | "PUT") => true,
        _ => false,
    };
    if produces_json && accepts_json(accept, false) != Some(true) {
        return Reply::Empty(406);
    }
    if rest.len() == 2 && (method == "GET" || method == "HEAD") {
        let reply = dispatch_inner(ctx, res, method, rest, query, body).await;
        if let Reply::Json(200, _) = reply {
            if accepts_json(accept, true) != Some(true) {
                return Reply::Empty(406);
            }
        }
        return reply;
    }
    dispatch_inner(ctx, res, method, rest, query, body).await
}

async fn dispatch_inner(
    ctx: &Ctx<'_>,
    res: Resource,
    method: &str,
    rest: &[String],
    query: Vec<(String, String)>,
    body: &str,
) -> Reply {
    let id_of = |s: &str| spring_parse_int(s);
    if method == "OPTIONS" {
        let allow = match rest.len() {
            0 => "POST,GET,HEAD,OPTIONS",
            1 => "DELETE,GET,HEAD,PUT,OPTIONS",
            2 if matches!((res, rest[1].as_str()), (Resource::Users, "userGroups") | (Resource::Groups, "users")) => {
                "GET,HEAD,OPTIONS"
            }
            _ => return Reply::Empty(404),
        };
        return Reply::Allow(allow);
    }
    match rest.len() {
        0 => match method {
            "GET" | "HEAD" => list_or_filter(ctx, res, &spring_param_order(query), false).await,
            "POST" => create(ctx, res, body).await,
            _ => Reply::Error(405),
        },
        1 => {
            if rest[0] == "filter" && (method == "GET" || method == "HEAD") {
                return list_or_filter(ctx, res, &spring_param_order(query), true).await;
            }
            match method {
                "GET" | "HEAD" | "PUT" | "DELETE" => {}
                _ => return Reply::Error(405),
            }
            let id = match id_of(&rest[0]) {
                Some(i) => i,
                None => return Reply::Error(400),
            };
            match method {
                "PUT" => update(ctx, res, id, body).await,
                "DELETE" => delete(ctx, res, id).await,
                _ => find_by_id(ctx, res, id).await,
            }
        }
        2 => {
            let sub = match (res, rest[1].as_str()) {
                (Resource::Users, "userGroups") => true,
                (Resource::Groups, "users") => false,
                _ => return Reply::Error(404),
            };
            if method != "GET" && method != "HEAD" {
                return Reply::Error(405);
            }
            let id = match id_of(&rest[0]) {
                Some(i) => i,
                None => return Reply::Error(400),
            };
            if sub {
                groups_of_user(ctx, id).await
            } else {
                users_of_group(ctx, id).await
            }
        }
        _ => Reply::Error(404),
    }
}

fn parse_local_date(t: &str) -> Option<NaiveDate> {
    // Joda ISODateTimeFormat.localDateParser(): yyyy[-MM[-dd]] | yyyy-DDD
    let (sign, body) = match t.as_bytes().first()? {
        b'-' => (-1, &t[1..]),
        b'+' => (1, &t[1..]),
        _ => (1, t),
    };
    let parts: Vec<&str> = body.split('-').collect();
    let num = |s: &str, min: usize, max: usize| -> Option<i32> {
        if s.len() < min || s.len() > max || !s.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
            return None;
        }
        s.parse().ok()
    };
    let year = sign * num(parts[0], 1, 9)?;
    match parts.len() {
        1 => NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(year, 1, 1),
        2 => {
            if parts[1].len() == 3 {
                let doy = num(parts[1], 3, 3)?;
                NaiveDate::from_yo_opt(year, doy as u32)
            } else {
                let m = num(parts[1], 1, 2)?;
                NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(year, m as u32, 1)
            }
        }
        3 => {
            let m = num(parts[1], 1, 2)?;
            let d = num(parts[2], 1, 2)?;
            NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(year, m as u32, d as u32)
        }
        _ => None,
    }
}

pub fn java_to_string(v: &Value) -> String {
    match v {
        Value::Null => "null".into(),
        Value::Bool(b) => b.to_string(),
        Value::String(s) => s.clone(),

            }

            let parts: Vec<String> = a.iter().map(java_to_string).collect();
            format!("[{}]", parts.join(", "))
        }
        Value::Object(m) => {
            let parts: Vec<String> = m.iter().map(|(k, v)| format!("{}={}", k, java_to_string(v))).collect();

/// `equals()` of the entity classes used in sets: `PersistentObject.equals`
/// compares class and creation time (equal for instances Jackson creates
/// within the same request) but not the id, followed by the class' fields.
fn java_equals(a: &V, b: &V) -> bool {
    match (a, b) {
        (V::Obj(x), V::Obj(y)) => {
            if x.class != y.class {
                return false;
            }
            let names: &[&str] = match x.class {
                Class::Role => &["name", "description"],
                Class::User => &["firstName", "lastName", "email", "birthday", "language", "accountName", "password", "active"],
                _ => return x == y,
            };
            names.iter().all(|n| x.get(n) == y.get(n))
        }
        _ => a == b,
    }
}

fn dedupe_set(v: V) -> V {
    match v {

            let mut out: Vec<V> = vec![];
            for i in items {
                if !out.iter().any(|o| java_equals(o, &i)) {
                    out.push(i);

            }
            V::List(out)
        }
        other => other,
    }
}

        Kind::Int(_, prim) => coerce_int(v, prim),
        Kind::Bool(_, prim) => coerce_bool(v, prim),
        Kind::Dbl(_) => coerce_double(v, false),
        Kind::Date(_) => coerce_date(v),
        Kind::Locale(_) => coerce_locale(v),
        Kind::Point(_, _) => coerce_point(v),
        Kind::ToOne { decl, .. } => read_decl(decl, v, ctx),
        Kind::EntSet { decl, .. } => {
            let l = match v {
                Value::Null => V::Null,
                Value::Array(a) => {

                        out.push(read_decl(decl, e, ctx)?);

        Kind::GroupRefs { .. } => {
            let l = match v {
                Value::Null => V::Null,
                Value::Array(a) => {

        Kind::DblList { .. } => read_list(v, |e| coerce_double(e, false)),

/// nested values are freshly constructed).

    apply_object_tracked(o, m, ctx, &mut vec![])
}

/// Like `apply_object`, recording the properties set before an error (the
/// original keeps – and commits – those on a failed update).
pub fn apply_object_tracked(
    o: &mut Obj,
    m: &Map<String, Value>,
    ctx: &mut ReadCtx,
    applied: &mut Vec<&'static str>,
) -> JResult<()> {
    apply_properties(o, m, ctx, applied)?;
    if ctx.unresolved {
        return Err("Unresolved forward references".into());
    }
    Ok(())

fn apply_properties(
    o: &mut Obj,
    m: &Map<String, Value>,
    ctx: &mut ReadCtx,
    applied: &mut Vec<&'static str>,
) -> JResult<()> {
    for (k, v) in m {
        if k == "id" {
            o.id = match coerce_int(v, false)? {
                V::Int(i) => Some(i),
                _ => None,
            };

        }

            continue;
        }

            .class
            .field(k)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Unrecognized field \"{}\" for {:?}", k, o.class))?;

        o.f.insert(fd.name, val);
        applied.push(fd.name);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn json_as_int(v: &Value) -> i32 {

                    let neg = s.starts_with('-');
                    let digits = s.trim_start_matches('-');
                    let mut acc: u32 = 0;
                    for c in digits.bytes() {
                        acc = acc.wrapping_mul(10).wrapping_add((c - b'0') as u32);
                    }
                    let r = acc as i32;
                    if neg {
                        r.wrapping_neg()
                    } else {
                        r
                    }
                }
            } else {
                let d = n.as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
                java_d2i(d)
            }
        }
        Value::String(s) => {
            let t = s.trim();
            if t.is_empty() {
                return 0;
            }
            if let Some(i) = java_parse_int(t) {
                return i;
            }
            match java_parse_double(t) {
                Some(d) => java_d2i(d),
                None => 0,
            }
        }
        Value::Bool(b) => *b as i32,
        _ => 0,
    }
}

fn java_d2i(d: f64) -> i32 {
    if d.is_nan() {
        0
    } else if d >= i32::MAX as f64 {
        i32::MAX
    } else if d <= i32::MIN as f64 {
        i32::MIN
    } else {
        d as i32
    }
}

/// `java.lang.Double.toString(double)`.
pub fn double_to_string(d: f64) -> String {
    if d.is_nan() {
        return "NaN".into();
    }
    if d.is_infinite() {
        return if d > 0.0 { "Infinity".into() } else { "-Infinity".into() };
    }
    if d == 0.0 {
        return if d.is_sign_negative() { "-0.0".into() } else { "0.0".into() };
    }
    // shortest round-trip digits
    let s = format!("{:e}", d.abs());
    let (mant, exp) = s.split_once('e').unwrap();
    let exp: i32 = exp.parse().unwrap();
    let digits: String = mant.chars().filter(|c| *c != '.').collect();
    let neg = if d < 0.0 { "-" } else { "" };
    let a = d.abs();
    if (1e-3..1e7).contains(&a) {
        // plain notation
        let point = exp + 1; // number of digits before the decimal point
        let mut out = String::new();
        if point <= 0 {
            out.push_str("0.");
            for _ in 0..(-point) {
                out.push('0');
            }
            out.push_str(&digits);
        } else {
            let p = point as usize;
            if digits.len() <= p {
                out.push_str(&digits);
                for _ in digits.len()..p {
                    out.push('0');
                }
                out.push_str(".0");
            } else {
                out.push_str(&digits[..p]);
                out.push('.');
                out.push_str(&digits[p..]);
            }
        }
        format!("{}{}", neg, out)
    } else {
        let first = &digits[..1];
        let rest = if digits.len() > 1 { &digits[1..] } else { "0" };
        format!("{}{}.{}E{}", neg, first, rest, exp)
    }

        .strip_suffix(['d', 'D', 'f', 'F'])
        .unwrap_or(body);

    let bytes = body.as_bytes();
    let mut i = 0;

    while i < bytes.len() && bytes[i].is_ascii_digit() {
        i += 1;
        nd += 1;

        i += 1;

    if nd == 0 {

    if i < bytes.len() && (bytes[i] == b'e' || bytes[i] == b'E') {

    if i != bytes.len() {

    }
    body.parse::<f64>().ok().map(|v| sign * v)

/// Minimal emulation of `java.util.HashMap<String, _>` key ordering.
pub struct JavaHashMap<V> {
    table: Vec<Vec<(String, u32, V)>>,
    threshold: usize,
    size: usize,
}

impl<V> JavaHashMap<V> {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        JavaHashMap { table: Vec::new(), threshold: 0, size: 0 }
    }
    pub fn with_capacity(initial: usize) -> Self {
        let mut n: usize = 1;
        while n < initial {
            n <<= 1;
        }
        JavaHashMap { table: Vec::new(), threshold: n, size: 0 }
    }
    fn resize(&mut self) {
        let old_cap = self.table.len();
        let old_thr = self.threshold;
        let (new_cap, mut new_thr);
        if old_cap > 0 {
            new_cap = old_cap << 1;
            new_thr = if old_cap >= 16 { old_thr << 1 } else { 0 };
        } else if old_thr > 0 {
            new_cap = old_thr;
            new_thr = 0;
        } else {
            new_cap = 16;
            new_thr = 12;
        }
        if new_thr == 0 {
            new_thr = ((new_cap as f32) * 0.75f32) as usize;
        }
        self.threshold = new_thr;
        let old = std::mem::take(&mut self.table);
        self.table = (0..new_cap).map(|_| Vec::new()).collect();
        for bucket in old {
            for (k, h, v) in bucket {
                let idx = (h as usize) & (new_cap - 1);
                self.table[idx].push((k, h, v));
            }
        }
    }
    pub fn get_mut(&mut self, key: &str) -> Option<&mut V> {
        if self.table.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let h = spread(java_string_hash(key));
        let idx = (h as usize) & (self.table.len() - 1);
        self.table[idx].iter_mut().find(|e| e.0 == key).map(|e| &mut e.2)
    }
    pub fn put(&mut self, key: String, v: V) {
        if let Some(slot) = self.get_mut(&key) {
            *slot = v;
            return;
        }
        if self.table.is_empty() {
            self.resize();
        }
        let h = spread(java_string_hash(&key));
        let idx = (h as usize) & (self.table.len() - 1);
        self.table[idx].push((key, h, v));
        self.size += 1;
        if self.size > self.threshold {
            self.resize();
        }
    }
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.size
    }
    pub fn into_entries(self) -> Vec<(String, V)> {
        self.table.into_iter().flatten().map(|(k, _, v)| (k, v)).collect()
    }
}

pub fn spring_param_order(params: Vec<(String, String)>) -> Vec<(String, Vec<String>)> {

    for (k, v) in params {
        if let Some(list) = mm.get_mut(&k) {
            list.push(v);

            }
            // Java: a zero-length leading match never happens here (comma required)
            if !(i == 0 && k == 0) {
                parts.push(chars[start..i].iter().collect::<String>());
                found = true;
            }
            start = k;
            i = k;
            continue;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    if !found {
        return vec![s.to_string()];
    }
    parts.push(chars[start..].iter().collect::<String>());
    while parts.len() > 0 && parts.last().map(|p| p.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false) {
        parts.pop();
    }
    parts
}

/// Java serialization of a `java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double` (what Hibernate
/// writes into the bytea column of the XYZ resolutions).
pub fn java_serialized_point(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out: Vec<u8> = vec![0xAC, 0xED, 0x00, 0x05, 0x73, 0x72, 0x00, 0x1C];
    out.extend_from_slice(b"java.awt.geom.Point2D$Double");
    out.extend_from_slice(&[0x55, 0x5B, 0xF8, 0xCA, 0x09, 0xA3, 0x1D, 0x5F, 0x02, 0x00, 0x02, 0x44, 0x00, 0x01, b'x', 0x44, 0x00, 0x01, b'y', 0x78, 0x70]);
    out.extend_from_slice(&x.to_bits().to_be_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&y.to_bits().to_be_bytes());
    out
}

/// Reads back a serialized `Point2D.Double` (x and y are the trailing 16 bytes).
pub fn java_deserialize_point(b: &[u8]) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
    if b.len() < 16 {
        return None;
    }
    let n = b.len();
    let mut x = [0u8; 8];
    let mut y = [0u8; 8];
    x.copy_from_slice(&b[n - 16..n - 8]);
    y.copy_from_slice(&b[n - 8..]);
    Some((f64::from_bits(u64::from_be_bytes(x)), f64::from_bits(u64::from_be_bytes(y))))
}

//! SHOGun-Core REST slice (users, groups, roles, layers, layer data sources,
//! layer appearances) as a Rust service.

mod api;
mod jackson;

use axum::extract::State;
use axum::http::{header, HeaderMap, HeaderValue, Request, Response};
use axum::Router;
use deadpool_postgres::{Manager, ManagerConfig, Pool, RecyclingMethod};
use security::{Auth, BasicHeader, BcryptCache, Evaluator, Sessions};
use std::str::FromStr;
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct AppState {
    pool: Pool,
    sessions: Sessions,
    bcrypt: BcryptCache,

fn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {
    percent_encoding::percent_decode_str(s).decode_utf8_lossy().to_string()
}

/// Query string parameters as Jetty decodes them ('+' = space, UTF-8).
fn parse_query(q: Option<&str>) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let mut out = vec![];
    let q = match q {
        Some(q) => q,
        None => return out,
    };
    for part in q.split('&') {
        if part.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let (k, v) = match part.find('=') {
            Some(i) => (&part[..i], &part[i + 1..]),
            None => (part, ""),
        };
        let dec = |s: &str| percent_decode(&s.replace('+', " "));
        out.push((dec(k), dec(v)));
    }
    out
}

fn reason(code: u16) -> &'static str {
    match code {
        400 => "Bad Request",
        401 => "Unauthorized",
        403 => "Forbidden",
        404 => "Not Found",
        405 => "Method Not Allowed",
        500 => "Server Error",
        _ => "Error",
    }
}

fn error_page(code: u16, path: &str) -> String {
    format!(
        "<html>\n<head>\n<meta http-equiv=\"Content-Type\" content=\"text/html;charset=utf-8\"/>\n<title>Error {c} {r}</title>\n</head>\n<body><h2>HTTP ERROR {c}</h2>\n<p>Problem accessing {p}. Reason:\n<pre>    {r}</pre></p>\n</body>\n</html>\n",
        c = code,
        r = reason(code),
        p = path
    )
}

fn build(reply: Reply, path: &str, head: bool) -> Response<Body> {
    let mut b = Response::builder();
    let resp = match reply {
        Reply::Json(code, v) => {
            b = b.status(code).header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json;charset=UTF-8");
            let body = serde_json::to_vec(&v).unwrap_or_default();
            b.body(if head { Body::empty() } else { Body::from(body) })
        }
        Reply::Empty(code) => b.status(code).header(header::CONTENT_LENGTH, "0").body(Body::empty()),
        Reply::Allow(methods) => b
            .status(200)
            .header(header::ALLOW, methods)
            .header(header::CONTENT_LENGTH, "0")
            .body(Body::empty()),
        Reply::Error(code) => {
            b = b.status(code).header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html;charset=iso-8859-1");
            b.body(if head { Body::empty() } else { Body::from(error_page(code, path)) })
        }
    };
    resp.unwrap_or_else(|_| Response::new(Body::empty()))
}

fn session_cookie(headers: &HeaderMap) -> Option<String> {
    for v in headers.get_all(header::COOKIE) {
        if let Ok(s) = v.to_str() {
            for c in s.split(';') {
                let c = c.trim();
                if let Some(id) = c.strip_prefix("JSESSIONID=") {
                    return Some(id.to_string());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn unauthorized(path: &str) -> Response<Body> {
    let mut r = build(Reply::Error(401), path, false);
    r.headers_mut()
        .insert(header::WWW_AUTHENTICATE, HeaderValue::from_static("Basic realm=\"SHOGun Realm\""));
    r
}

/// Character encoding Jetty would use for `request.getReader()`.
fn decode_body(headers: &HeaderMap, bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    let ct = headers
        .get(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .unwrap_or("")
        .to_ascii_lowercase();
    let charset = ct
        .split(';')
        .filter_map(|p| p.trim().strip_prefix("charset=").map(|c| c.trim_matches('"').to_string()))
        .next();
    let latin1 = match charset.as_deref() {
        Some("utf-8") | Some("utf8") => false,
        Some("iso-8859-1") | Some("latin1") | Some("us-ascii") => true,
        Some(_) => false,
        None => !ct.starts_with("application/json"),
    };
    if latin1 {
        bytes.iter().map(|b| *b as char).collect()
    } else {
        String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).to_string()
    }
}

fn is_normalized(path: &str) -> bool {
    let b = path.as_bytes();
    let mut i = b.len();
    while i > 0 {
        let slash = b[..i].iter().rposition(|c| *c == b'/');
        let slash_index: isize = slash.map(|x| x as isize).unwrap_or(-1);
        let gap = i as isize - slash_index;
        let next = (slash_index + 1) as usize;
        if gap == 2 && b[next] == b'.' {
            return false;
        }
        if gap == 3 && b[next] == b'.' && b[next + 1] == b'.' {
            return false;
        }
        if slash_index < 0 {
            break;
        }
        i = slash_index as usize;
    }
    true
}

/// Spring Security's `StrictHttpFirewall` (a rejected request ends in 500).
fn firewall_rejects(method: &str, raw_path: &str, decoded: &str) -> bool {
    const METHODS: [&str; 7] = ["DELETE", "GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "PATCH", "POST", "PUT"];
    if !METHODS.contains(&method) {
        return true;
    }
    const ENCODED: [&str; 26] = [
        ";", "%3b", "%3B", "%2f", "%2F", "//", "%2f%2f", "%2f%2F", "%2F%2f", "%2F%2F", "\\", "%5c", "%5C", "\0", "%00",
        "%25", "%2e", "%2E", "\n", "%0a", "%0A", "\r", "%0d", "%0D", "\u{2028}", "\u{2029}",
    ];
    const DECODED: [&str; 11] = [";", "//", "\\", "\0", "%", "\n", "\r", "\u{2028}", "\u{2029}", "%2f", "%2F"];
    if ENCODED.iter().any(|x| raw_path.contains(x)) || DECODED.iter().any(|x| decoded.contains(x)) {
        return true;
    }
    if !is_normalized(raw_path) || !is_normalized(decoded) {
        return true;
    }
    !raw_path.bytes().all(|c| (0x20..=0x7e).contains(&c))
}

async fn handle(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>, req: Request<Body>) -> Response<Body> {
    let (parts, body) = req.into_parts();
    let raw_path = parts.uri.path().to_string();
    let method = parts.method.as_str().to_string();
    let head = method == "HEAD";

    if method == "TRACE" {
        // disabled by the servlet container
        return build(Reply::Empty(403), &raw_path, head);
    }
    if !(raw_path == "/rest" || raw_path.starts_with("/rest/")) {
        return build(Reply::Error(404), &raw_path, head);
    }
    let decoded = percent_decode(&raw_path);
    if firewall_rejects(&method, &raw_path, &decoded) {
        return build(Reply::Error(500), &raw_path, head);
    }

    // ---- security filter chain ------------------------------------------
    let mut new_session: Option<String> = None;
    let session_id = session_cookie(&parts.headers).filter(|id| state.sessions.get(id).is_some());
    let session_auth: Option<Auth> = session_id.as_ref().and_then(|id| state.sessions.get(id)).flatten();
    let authz = parts.headers.get(header::AUTHORIZATION).and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok());
    let auth: Option<Auth> = match security::parse_basic(authz) {
        BasicHeader::Absent => session_auth,
        BasicHeader::Invalid => {
            if let Some(id) = &session_id {
                state.sessions.set(id, None);
            }
            None
        }
        BasicHeader::Credentials(user, pw) => {
            let client = match state.pool.get().await {
                Ok(c) => c,
                Err(e) => {
                    api::tracing_log(&e.to_string());
                    return build(Reply::Error(500), &raw_path, head);
                }
            };
            match security::authenticate(&**client, &state.bcrypt, &user, &pw).await {
                Ok(Some(a)) => {
                    let sid = match &session_id {
                        Some(id) => id.clone(),
                        None => {
                            let id = state.sessions.create();
                            new_session = Some(id.clone());
                            id
                        }
                    };
                    state.sessions.set(&sid, Some(a.clone()));
                    Some(a)
                }
                Ok(None) => {
                    if let Some(id) = &session_id {
                        state.sessions.set(id, None);
                    }
                    None
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    api::tracing_log(&e);
                    return build(Reply::Error(500), &raw_path, head);
                }
            }
        }
    };
    let with_cookie = |mut r: Response<Body>, sid: &Option<String>| {
        if let Some(id) = sid {
            if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("JSESSIONID={};Path=/", id)) {
                r.headers_mut().insert(header::SET_COOKIE, v);
            }
        }
        r
    };
    let auth = match auth {
        Some(a) => a,
        None => {
            if session_id.is_none() && new_session.is_none() {
                new_session = Some(state.sessions.create());
            }
            return with_cookie(unauthorized(&raw_path), &new_session);
        }
    };

    // path segments below /rest
    let after = decoded.strip_prefix("/rest").unwrap_or("");
    let mut segs: Vec<String> = after.split('/').skip(1).map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    let resource = segs.first().and_then(|s| Resource::from_segment(s));
    let resource = match resource {
        Some(r) => r,
        None => {
            // everything else under /rest is for admins only
            let code = if auth.is_admin() { 404 } else { 403 };
            return with_cookie(build(Reply::Error(code), &raw_path, head), &new_session);
        }
    };
    if !auth.is_user() {
        return with_cookie(build(Reply::Error(403), &raw_path, head), &new_session);
    }
    segs.remove(0);
    // trailing slash match
    if segs.last().map(|s| s.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false) {
        segs.pop();
    }
    if segs.iter().any(|s| s.is_empty()) {
        return with_cookie(build(Reply::Error(404), &raw_path, head), &new_session);
    }

    let bytes = match to_bytes(body, 64 * 1024 * 1024).await {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(_) => return with_cookie(build(Reply::Error(400), &raw_path, head), &new_session),
    };
    let body_text = decode_body(&parts.headers, &bytes);
    let query = parse_query(parts.uri.query());

    let ev = {
        let client = match state.pool.get().await {
            Ok(c) => c,
            Err(e) => {
                api::tracing_log(&e.to_string());
                return with_cookie(build(Reply::Error(500), &raw_path, head), &new_session);
            }
        };
        match Evaluator::load(&**client, &auth).await {
            Ok(ev) => ev,
            Err(e) => {
                api::tracing_log(&e);
                return with_cookie(build(Reply::Error(500), &raw_path, head), &new_session);
            }
        }
    };
    let ctx = Ctx { pool: &state.pool, ev: &ev };
    let accept = parts.headers.get(header::ACCEPT).and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok());
    let reply = api::dispatch(&ctx, resource, &method, &segs, query, &body_text, accept).await;
    with_cookie(build(reply, &raw_path, head), &new_session)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let url = std::env::var("DATABASE_URL").expect("DATABASE_URL must be set");
    let port: u16 = std::env::var("PORT").ok().and_then(|p| p.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(8080);
    let pg = tokio_postgres::Config::from_str(&url).expect("invalid DATABASE_URL");
    let mgr = Manager::from_config(pg, tokio_postgres::NoTls, ManagerConfig { recycling_method: RecyclingMethod::Fast });
    let pool = Pool::builder(mgr).max_size(16).build().expect("pool");
    let state = Arc::new(AppState { pool, sessions: Sessions::default(), bcrypt: BcryptCache::default() });
    let app = Router::new().fallback(handle).with_state(state);
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("0.0.0.0", port)).await.expect("bind");
    axum::serve(listener, app).await.expect("server");
}

    /// and filters, with their Java types.
    pub fn simple_fields(self) -> Vec<(&'static str, SimpleType, Option<(&'static str, &'static str)>)> {
        // (property, type, (table, column)); "id" handled by caller
        let mut out = vec![];
        for f in self.fields() {
            let t = match f.kind {
                Kind::Str(c) => Some((SimpleType::Str, c)),
                Kind::Int(c, _) => Some((SimpleType::Int, c)),
                Kind::Bool(c, _) => Some((SimpleType::Bool, c)),
                Kind::Dbl(c) => Some((SimpleType::Dbl, c)),
                _ => None,
            };
            if let Some((ty, col)) = t {
                out.push((f.name, ty, Some((f.table, col))));
            }

    }

    /// A fresh instance as created by the Java default constructor.
    pub fn new(class: Class) -> Obj {
        let mut f = BTreeMap::new();
        for fd in class.fields() {
            f.insert(fd.name, class.default_value(fd.name));
        }
        Obj { class, id: None, f }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, name: &str) -> &V {
        self.f.get(name).unwrap_or(&V::Null)
    }

//! HTTP Basic authentication against the users table, the servlet session
//! that keeps the authentication, and the entity permission evaluators.

use crate::model::Class;
use base64::Engine;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use tokio_postgres::GenericClient;

pub const SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE: &str = "ROLE_ADMIN";
pub const DEFAULT_USER_ROLE: &str = "ROLE_USER";

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Auth {
    pub user_id: i32,
    pub authorities: HashSet<String>,
}

impl Auth {
    /// `hasRole(superAdminRoleName)`
    pub fn is_admin(&self) -> bool {
        self.authorities.contains(SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE)
    }
    /// `hasRole(defaultUserRoleName)` with the hierarchy ROLE_ADMIN > ROLE_USER
    pub fn is_user(&self) -> bool {
        self.is_admin() || self.authorities.contains(DEFAULT_USER_ROLE)
    }
}

/// In-memory servlet sessions (JSESSIONID -> authentication).
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Sessions {
    map: Mutex<HashMap<String, Option<Auth>>>,
}

impl Sessions {
    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<Option<Auth>> {
        self.map.lock().unwrap().get(id).cloned()
    }
    pub fn set(&self, id: &str, auth: Option<Auth>) {
        self.map.lock().unwrap().insert(id.to_string(), auth);
    }
    pub fn create(&self) -> String {
        let id = format!("node0{}.node0", random_token());
        self.map.lock().unwrap().insert(id.clone(), None);
        id
    }
}

fn random_token() -> String {
    use rand::Rng;
    let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
    (0..26)
        .map(|_| {
            let n = rng.gen_range(0..36u8);
            if n < 10 {
                (b'0' + n) as char
            } else {
                (b'a' + n - 10) as char
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Cache of successful/failed bcrypt checks: (raw password, stored hash) -> result.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct BcryptCache {
    map: Mutex<HashMap<(String, String), bool>>,
}

fn looks_like_bcrypt(h: &str) -> bool {
    // \A\$2(a|y|b)?\$(\d\d)\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{53}
    let b = h.as_bytes();
    if !h.starts_with("$2") {
        return false;
    }
    let mut i = 2;
    if i < b.len() && (b[i] == b'a' || b[i] == b'y' || b[i] == b'b') {
        i += 1;
    }
    if i >= b.len() || b[i] != b'$' {
        return false;
    }
    i += 1;
    if i + 2 >= b.len() || !b[i].is_ascii_digit() || !b[i + 1].is_ascii_digit() || b[i + 2] != b'$' {
        return false;
    }
    i += 3;
    let rest = &b[i..];
    rest.len() == 53 && rest.iter().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *c == b'.' || *c == b'/')
}

impl BcryptCache {
    pub fn matches(&self, raw: &str, hash: &str) -> bool {
        if hash.is_empty() || !looks_like_bcrypt(hash) {
            return false;
        }
        let key = (raw.to_string(), hash.to_string());
        if let Some(r) = self.map.lock().unwrap().get(&key) {
            return *r;
        }
        // bcrypt crate understands $2a$/$2b$/$2y$; "$2$" is treated as $2a$
        let h = if hash.starts_with("$2$") { format!("$2a${}", &hash[3..]) } else { hash.to_string() };
        let ok = bcrypt::verify(raw, &h).unwrap_or(false);
        self.map.lock().unwrap().insert(key, ok);
        ok
    }
}

pub enum BasicHeader {
    /// no (Basic) Authorization header
    Absent,
    /// header present but unusable
    Invalid,
    Credentials(String, String),
}

/// Spring Security's `BasicAuthenticationConverter`.
pub fn parse_basic(header: Option<&str>) -> BasicHeader {
    let h = match header {
        None => return BasicHeader::Absent,
        Some(h) => h.trim(),
    };
    if h.len() < 5 || !h[..5].eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
        return BasicHeader::Absent;
    }
    if h.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
        return BasicHeader::Invalid;
    }
    let token = if h.len() > 6 { &h[6..] } else { "" };
    let decoded = match base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(token.as_bytes())
        .or_else(|_| base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD_NO_PAD.decode(token.as_bytes()))
    {
        Ok(d) => d,
        Err(_) => return BasicHeader::Invalid,
    };
    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&decoded).to_string();
    match s.find(':') {
        None => BasicHeader::Invalid,
        Some(i) => BasicHeader::Credentials(s[..i].to_string(), s[i + 1..].to_string()),
    }
}

/// `ShogunCoreAuthenticationProvider.authenticate`; `None` = 401.
pub async fn authenticate<C: GenericClient + Sync>(
    c: &C,
    cache: &BcryptCache,
    account: &str,
    password: &str,
) -> Result<Option<Auth>, String> {
    let rows = c
        .query(
            "SELECT u.id, u.active, u.password FROM users u JOIN persons p ON p.id = u.id WHERE u.accountname = $1",
            &[&account],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if rows.len() != 1 {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let row = &rows[0];
    let id: i32 = row.get(0);
    let active: Option<bool> = row.get(1);
    let hash: Option<String> = row.get(2);
    if !active.unwrap_or(false) {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let hash = hash.unwrap_or_default();
    if !cache.matches(password, &hash) {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let roles = c
        .query(
            "SELECT r.name FROM users_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = $1 \
             UNION SELECT r.name FROM user_usergroup m JOIN usergroups_roles gr ON gr.usergroup_id = m.usergroup_id \
             JOIN roles r ON r.id = gr.role_id WHERE m.user_id = $1",
            &[&id],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let authorities: HashSet<String> = roles.iter().filter_map(|r| r.get::<_, Option<String>>(0)).collect();
    if authorities.is_empty() {
        // unauthenticated token: access is refused with 401
        return Ok(None);
    }
    Ok(Some(Auth { user_id: id, authorities }))
}

/// Permission data of the logged in user (`ShogunCorePermissionEvaluator`
/// with the library's entity permission evaluators).
pub struct Evaluator {
    pub admin: bool,
    /// the user as found in the database (None if it no longer exists)
    user: Option<i32>,
    groups: HashSet<i32>,
    user_perms: HashMap<i32, HashSet<String>>,
    group_perms: HashMap<i32, HashSet<String>>,
}

impl Evaluator {
    pub async fn load<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, auth: &Auth) -> Result<Evaluator, String> {
        let admin = auth.is_admin();
        let uid = auth.user_id;
        let exists = c
            .query_opt("SELECT 1 FROM users u JOIN persons p ON p.id = u.id WHERE u.id = $1", &[&uid])
            .await
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            .is_some();
        let mut ev = Evaluator {
            admin,
            user: if exists { Some(uid) } else { None },
            groups: HashSet::new(),
            user_perms: HashMap::new(),
            group_perms: HashMap::new(),
        };
        if !exists || admin {
            return Ok(ev);
        }
        for r in c
            .query("SELECT usergroup_id FROM user_usergroup WHERE user_id = $1", &[&uid])
            .await
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        {
            ev.groups.insert(r.get(0));
        }
        for r in c
            .query(
                "SELECT up.entity_id, p.permissions FROM userpermissions up \
                 JOIN permissioncollections_permissions p ON p.permissioncollections_id = up.userpermissions_id \
                 WHERE up.userpermissions_key = $1",
                &[&uid],
            )
            .await
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        {
            let eid: i32 = r.get(0);
            let p: Option<String> = r.get(1);
            if let Some(p) = p {
                ev.user_perms.entry(eid).or_default().insert(p);
            }
        }
        for r in c
            .query(
                "SELECT gp.entity_id, p.permissions FROM grouppermissions gp \
                 JOIN user_usergroup m ON m.usergroup_id = gp.grouppermissions_key AND m.user_id = $1 \
                 JOIN permissioncollections_permissions p ON p.permissioncollections_id = gp.grouppermissions_id",
                &[&uid],
            )
            .await
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        {
            let eid: i32 = r.get(0);
            let p: Option<String> = r.get(1);
            if let Some(p) = p {
                ev.group_perms.entry(eid).or_default().insert(p);
            }
        }
        Ok(ev)
    }

    fn generic(&self, id: Option<i32>, perm: Perm) -> bool {
        let id = match (self.user, id) {
            (Some(_), Some(id)) => id,
            _ => return false,
        };
        let has = |m: &HashMap<i32, HashSet<String>>| {
            m.get(&id).map(|s| s.contains(perm.name()) || s.contains("ADMIN")).unwrap_or(false)
        };
        has(&self.user_perms) || has(&self.group_perms)
    }

    /// `hasPermission(entity, perm)` for an entity loaded from the database.
    pub fn has_permission(&self, class: Class, id: Option<i32>, perm: Perm) -> bool {
        match class {
            Class::Role
            | Class::LayerAppearance
            | Class::Extent
            | Class::TileGrid
            | Class::WmtsTileGrid
            | Class::ImageWms
            | Class::TileWms
            | Class::Wfs
            | Class::Wmts
            | Class::Xyz => {
                if perm == Perm::Read {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            Class::User => {
                if perm == Perm::Read && self.user.is_some() && self.user == id {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            Class::UserGroup => {
                if perm == Perm::Read && self.user.is_some() {
                    if let Some(id) = id {
                        if self.groups.contains(&id) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Class::Layer => {}
        }
        self.generic(id, perm)
    }

    /// `hasRole(admin) or hasPermission(entity, perm)`
    pub fn allowed(&self, class: Class, id: Option<i32>, perm: Perm) -> bool {
        self.admin || self.has_permission(class, id, perm)
    }

    /// Permission check on a generic entity id (e.g. a map module).
    pub fn allowed_generic(&self, id: i32, perm: Perm) -> bool {
        self.admin || self.generic(Some(id), perm)
    }
}

//! entity -> JSON (what Jackson writes for the original's entities)

use crate::model::{Kind, Obj, V};
use serde_json::{Map, Number, Value};

fn num(d: f64) -> Value {
    Number::from_f64(d).map(Value::Number).unwrap_or(Value::Null)
}

fn point(x: f64, y: f64) -> Value {
    let mut m = Map::new();
    m.insert("x".into(), num(x));
    m.insert("y".into(), num(y));
    Value::Object(m)
}

pub fn value(v: &V) -> Value {
    match v {
        V::Null => Value::Null,
        V::Str(s) => Value::String(s.clone()),
        V::Int(i) => Value::Number((*i).into()),
        V::Bool(b) => Value::Bool(*b),
        V::Dbl(d) => num(*d),
        V::Date(d) => Value::String(d.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string()),
        V::Locale(s) => Value::String(s.clone()),
        V::Point(x, y) => point(*x, *y),
        V::Obj(o) => obj(o),
        V::Ref(i) => Value::Number((*i).into()),
        V::List(items) => Value::Array(items.iter().map(value).collect()),
        V::Props(p) => {
            let mut m = Map::new();
            for (k, pv) in p {
                m.insert(k.clone(), pv.json.clone());
            }
            Value::Object(m)
        }
    }
}

//! Database access: loading entity graphs, writing them back the way
//! Hibernate does, deleting, and the list / filter queries.

use crate::javaish::{is_digits, is_parsable, java_deserialize_point, java_parse_double, java_parse_long, java_serialized_point, locale_from_db};
use crate::model::{Class, Decl, Family, Kind, Obj, PropVal, SimpleType, V};
use chrono::NaiveDateTime;
use serde_json::{Number, Value};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::future::Future;
use std::pin::Pin;
use tokio_postgres::types::ToSql;
use tokio_postgres::{GenericClient, Row};

pub type DbResult<T> = Result<T, String>;
type BoxFut<'a, T> = Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = T> + Send + 'a>>;

fn e2s(e: tokio_postgres::Error) -> String {
    match e.as_db_error() {
        Some(d) => format!("{}: {}", d.code().code(), d.message()),
        None => e.to_string(),

/// Loads entity graphs; keeps every entity it touched (like a Hibernate
/// session) so the same row is only read once per request.
pub struct Loader<'c, C: GenericClient + Sync> {
    pub client: &'c C,
    cache: HashMap<(Family, i32), Option<Obj>>,
}

fn select_columns(class: Class) -> (String, Vec<&'static crate::model::Field>) {
    let mut cols = vec![];
    let mut fields = vec![];
    for f in class.fields() {
        match f.kind {
            Kind::Str(c) | Kind::Int(c, _) | Kind::Bool(c, _) | Kind::Dbl(c) | Kind::Date(c) | Kind::Locale(c) => {
                cols.push(format!("{}.{}", f.table, c));
                fields.push(f);
            }
            Kind::Point(x, y) => {
                cols.push(format!("{}.{}", f.table, x));
                cols.push(format!("{}.{}", f.table, y));
                fields.push(f);
            }
            Kind::ToOne { col, .. } => {
                cols.push(format!("{}.{}", f.table, col));
                fields.push(f);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    (cols.join(", "), fields)
}

pub fn from_clause(class: Class) -> String {
    let tables = class.tables();
    let mut s = tables[0].to_string();
    for t in &tables[1..] {
        s.push_str(&format!(" JOIN {} ON {}.id = {}.id", t, t, tables[0]));
    }
    s
}

/// Converts a stored property value like the original's `PropertyValueConverter`.
pub fn prop_from_db(text: &str) -> DbResult<Value> {
    if text.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") {
        return Ok(Value::Bool(true));
    }
    if text.eq_ignore_ascii_case("false") {
        return Ok(Value::Bool(false));
    }
    if is_parsable(text) {
        let digits = is_digits(text) || (text.starts_with('-') && is_digits(&text[1..]));
        if digits {
            let l = java_parse_long(text).ok_or("NumberFormatException")?;
            return Ok(Value::Number(l.into()));
        }
        let d = java_parse_double(text).ok_or("NumberFormatException")?;
        return Ok(Number::from_f64(d).map(Value::Number).unwrap_or(Value::Null));
    }
    Ok(Value::String(text.to_string()))
}

impl<'c, C: GenericClient + Sync> Loader<'c, C> {
    pub fn new(client: &'c C) -> Self {
        Loader { client, cache: HashMap::new() }
    }

    /// (family, id) of every entity read so far.
    pub fn loaded(&self) -> HashSet<(Family, i32)> {
        self.cache.iter().filter(|(_, v)| v.is_some()).map(|(k, _)| *k).collect()
    }

    pub async fn lds_class(&self, id: i32) -> DbResult<Option<Class>> {
        let row = self
            .client
            .query_opt(
                "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tilewmslayerdatasources t WHERE t.id = l.id), \
                        (SELECT count(*) FROM imagewmslayerdatasources t WHERE t.id = l.id), \
                        (SELECT count(*) FROM wfslayerdatasources t WHERE t.id = l.id), \
                        (SELECT count(*) FROM wmtslayerdatasources t WHERE t.id = l.id), \
                        (SELECT count(*) FROM xyzlayerdatasources t WHERE t.id = l.id) \
                 FROM layerdatasources l WHERE l.id = $1",
                &[&id],
            )
            .await
            .map_err(e2s)?;
        let row = match row {
            None => return Ok(None),
            Some(r) => r,
        };
        let c: Vec<i64> = (0..5).map(|i| row.get::<_, i64>(i)).collect();
        Ok(if c[0] > 0 {
            Some(Class::TileWms)
        } else if c[1] > 0 {
            Some(Class::ImageWms)
        } else if c[2] > 0 {
            Some(Class::Wfs)
        } else if c[3] > 0 {
            Some(Class::Wmts)
        } else if c[4] > 0 {
            Some(Class::Xyz)
        } else {
            return Err("cannot instantiate abstract class LayerDataSource".into());
        })
    }

    pub async fn tilegrid_class(&self, id: i32) -> DbResult<Option<Class>> {
        let row = self
            .client
            .query_opt(
                "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM wmtstilegrids w WHERE w.id = t.id) FROM tilegrids t WHERE t.id = $1",
                &[&id],
            )
            .await
            .map_err(e2s)?;
        Ok(row.map(|r| if r.get::<_, i64>(0) > 0 { Class::WmtsTileGrid } else { Class::TileGrid }))
    }

    /// Loads the entity with the given id as the declared type (polymorphic
    /// for data sources and tile grids).
    pub fn load_decl<'a>(&'a mut self, decl: Decl, id: i32) -> BoxFut<'a, DbResult<Option<Obj>>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let class = match decl {
                Decl::Lds => match self.lds_class(id).await? {
                    Some(c) => c,
                    None => return Ok(None),
                },
                Decl::TileGrid | Decl::WmtsTileGrid => match self.tilegrid_class(id).await? {
                    Some(c) => {
                        if decl == Decl::WmtsTileGrid && c != Class::WmtsTileGrid {
                            return Err("wrong tile grid type".into());
                        }
                        c
                    }
                    None => return Ok(None),
                },
                other => other.class().unwrap(),
            };
            self.load(class, id).await
        })
    }

    /// Loads an entity of exactly this class (for data sources use
    /// `load_decl`).
    pub fn load<'a>(&'a mut self, class: Class, id: i32) -> BoxFut<'a, DbResult<Option<Obj>>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let key = (class.family(), id);
            if let Some(c) = self.cache.get(&key) {
                if let Some(o) = c {
                    if o.class == class {
                        return Ok(Some(o.clone()));
                    }
                    return Ok(None);
                }
                return Ok(None);
            }
            let (cols, fields) = select_columns(class);
            let tables = class.tables();
            let sql = format!(
                "SELECT {}.id{}{} FROM {} WHERE {}.id = $1",
                tables[0],
                if cols.is_empty() { "" } else { ", " },
                cols,
                from_clause(class),
                tables[0]
            );
            let row = self.client.query_opt(sql.as_str(), &[&id]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
            let row = match row {
                None => {
                    self.cache.insert(key, None);
                    return Ok(None);
                }
                Some(r) => r,
            };
            let mut o = Obj::new(class);
            o.id = Some(id);
            self.fill_scalars(&mut o, &row, 1, &fields).await?;
            // collections
            for f in class.fields() {
                let v = self.load_collection(&f.kind, id).await?;
                if let Some(v) = v {
                    o.f.insert(f.name, v);
                }
            }
            self.cache.insert(key, Some(o.clone()));
            Ok(Some(o))
        })
    }

    async fn fill_scalars(
        &mut self,
        o: &mut Obj,
        row: &Row,
        start: usize,
        fields: &[&'static crate::model::Field],
    ) -> DbResult<()> {
        let mut i = start;
        for f in fields {
            let v = match f.kind {
                Kind::Str(_) => {
                    let s: Option<String> = row.get(i);
                    i += 1;
                    s.map(V::Str).unwrap_or(V::Null)
                }
                Kind::Int(_, prim) => {
                    let s: Option<i32> = row.get(i);
                    i += 1;
                    match s {
                        Some(x) => V::Int(x),
                        None if prim => V::Int(0),
                        None => V::Null,
                    }
                }
                Kind::Bool(_, prim) => {
                    let s: Option<bool> = row.get(i);
                    i += 1;
                    match s {
                        Some(x) => V::Bool(x),
                        None if prim => V::Bool(false),
                        None => V::Null,
                    }
                }
                Kind::Dbl(_) => {
                    let s: Option<f64> = row.get(i);
                    i += 1;
                    s.map(V::Dbl).unwrap_or(V::Null)
                }
                Kind::Date(_) => {
                    let s: Option<chrono::NaiveDate> = row.get(i);
                    i += 1;
                    s.map(V::Date).unwrap_or(V::Null)
                }
                Kind::Locale(_) => {
                    let s: Option<String> = row.get(i);
                    i += 1;
                    s.map(|s| V::Locale(locale_from_db(&s))).unwrap_or(V::Null)
                }
                Kind::Point(_, _) => {
                    let x: Option<f64> = row.get(i);
                    let y: Option<f64> = row.get(i + 1);
                    i += 2;
                    if x.is_none() && y.is_none() {
                        V::Null
                    } else {
                        V::Point(x.unwrap_or(0.0), y.unwrap_or(0.0))
                    }
                }
                Kind::ToOne { decl, .. } => {
                    let r: Option<i32> = row.get(i);
                    i += 1;
                    match r {
                        None => V::Null,
                        Some(rid) => match self.load_decl(decl, rid).await? {
                            Some(t) => V::Obj(Box::new(t)),
                            None => V::Null,
                        },
                    }
                }
                _ => continue,
            };
            o.f.insert(f.name, v);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn load_collection(&mut self, kind: &Kind, id: i32) -> DbResult<Option<V>> {
        let c = self.client;
        Ok(Some(match *kind {
            Kind::EntSet { table, owner, elem, decl } => {
                let rows = c
                    .query(format!("SELECT {} FROM {} WHERE {} = $1", elem, table, owner).as_str(), &[&id])
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                let mut out = vec![];
                for r in rows {
                    let eid: i32 = r.get(0);
                    if let Some(o) = self.load_decl(decl, eid).await? {
                        out.push(V::Obj(Box::new(o)));
                    }
                }
                V::List(out)
            }
            Kind::GroupRefs { table, owner, elem } => {
                let rows = c
                    .query(
                        format!("SELECT j.{} FROM {} j JOIN usergroups g ON g.id = j.{} WHERE j.{} = $1", elem, table, elem, owner)
                            .as_str(),
                        &[&id],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                V::List(rows.iter().map(|r| V::Ref(r.get(0))).collect())
            }
            Kind::StrBag { table, owner, col } => {
                let rows = c
                    .query(format!("SELECT {} FROM {} WHERE {} = $1", col, table, owner).as_str(), &[&id])
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                V::List(
                    rows.iter()
                        .filter_map(|r| r.get::<_, Option<String>>(0))
                        .map(V::Str)
                        .collect(),
                )
            }
            Kind::DblList { table, owner, col, idx } => {
                let rows = c
                    .query(
                        format!("SELECT {}, {} FROM {} WHERE {} = $1 ORDER BY {}", col, idx, table, owner, idx).as_str(),
                        &[&id],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                let mut list: Vec<V> = vec![];
                for r in rows {
                    let v: Option<f64> = r.get(0);
                    let i: i32 = r.get(1);
                    if i < 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let i = i as usize;
                    while list.len() <= i {
                        list.push(V::Null);
                    }
                    list[i] = v.map(V::Dbl).unwrap_or(V::Null);
                }
                V::List(list)
            }
            Kind::XyzRes => {
                let rows = c
                    .query(
                        "SELECT resolution, idx FROM xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution WHERE xyzlayerdatasrc_id = $1 ORDER BY idx",
                        &[&id],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                let mut list: Vec<V> = vec![];
                for r in rows {
                    let v: Option<Vec<u8>> = r.get(0);
                    let i: i32 = r.get(1);
                    if i < 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let i = i as usize;
                    while list.len() <= i {
                        list.push(V::Null);
                    }
                    list[i] = v.and_then(|b| java_deserialize_point(&b)).map(|(x, y)| V::Point(x, y)).unwrap_or(V::Null);
                }
                V::List(list)
            }
            Kind::Props => {
                let rows = c
                    .query("SELECT property, value FROM layerappearances_properties WHERE appearance_id = $1", &[&id])
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                let mut out = vec![];
                for r in rows {
                    let k: String = r.get(0);
                    let v: Option<String> = r.get(1);
                    if let Some(t) = v {
                        out.push((k, PropVal { json: prop_from_db(&t)?, text: Some(t) }));
                    }
                }
                V::Props(out)
            }
            _ => return Ok(None),
        }))
    }

    /// Loads a root entity of a resource (polymorphic for data sources).
    pub async fn load_resource(&mut self, class: Class, id: i32) -> DbResult<Option<Obj>> {
        match class.family() {
            Family::Lds => self.load_decl(Decl::Lds, id).await,
            _ => self.load(class, id).await,
        }
    }
}

// queries for list / filter endpoints

pub enum Param {
    Str(String),
    Int(i32),
    Bool(bool),
    Dbl(f64),
}

impl Param {
    fn as_sql(&self) -> &(dyn ToSql + Sync) {
        match self {
            Param::Str(s) => s,
            Param::Int(i) => i,
            Param::Bool(b) => b,
            Param::Dbl(d) => d,
        }
    }
}

/// A filter: AND over properties, OR over the values of each property.
/// Each entry: (qualified column, values).
pub type Filter = Vec<(String, Vec<Param>)>;

fn where_clause<'a>(filter: &'a Filter, params: &mut Vec<&'a (dyn ToSql + Sync)>) -> String {
    let mut ands = vec![];
    for (col, vals) in filter {
        let mut ors = vec![];
        for v in vals {
            params.push(v.as_sql());
            ors.push(format!("{} = ${}", col, params.len()));
        }
        ands.push(format!("({})", ors.join(" OR ")));
    }
    if ands.is_empty() {
        String::new()
    } else {
        format!(" WHERE {}", ands.join(" AND "))
    }
}

/// The table/alias whose rows are the resource's entities.
pub fn resource_from(class: Class) -> (String, &'static str) {
    match class.family() {
        Family::Lds => ("layerdatasources".into(), "layerdatasources"),
        Family::Person => ("users JOIN persons ON persons.id = users.id".into(), "persons"),
        _ => {
            let t = class.tables()[0];
            (t.into(), t)
        }
    }
}

pub fn lds_from() -> String {
    "layerdatasources \
     LEFT JOIN imagewmslayerdatasources ON imagewmslayerdatasources.id = layerdatasources.id \
     LEFT JOIN tilewmslayerdatasources ON tilewmslayerdatasources.id = layerdatasources.id \
     LEFT JOIN wfslayerdatasources ON wfslayerdatasources.id = layerdatasources.id \
     LEFT JOIN wmtslayerdatasources ON wmtslayerdatasources.id = layerdatasources.id \
     LEFT JOIN xyzlayerdatasources ON xyzlayerdatasources.id = layerdatasources.id"
        .into()
}

pub async fn query_ids<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, class: Class, filter: &Filter) -> DbResult<Vec<i32>> {
    let (from, root) = resource_from(class);
    let from = if class.family() == Family::Lds { lds_from() } else { from };
    let mut params: Vec<&(dyn ToSql + Sync)> = vec![];
    let w = where_clause(filter, &mut params);
    let sql = format!("SELECT DISTINCT {}.id FROM {}{}", root, from, w);
    let rows = c.query(sql.as_str(), &params).await.map_err(e2s)?;
    Ok(rows.iter().map(|r| r.get(0)).collect())
}

/// Projection query for `output:only`: returns beans with only the given
/// properties set (the rest keeps the constructor defaults).
pub async fn query_restricted<C: GenericClient + Sync>(
    c: &C,
    class: Class,
    props: &[(&'static str, SimpleType, String)],
    filter: &Filter,
) -> DbResult<Vec<Obj>> {
    let (from, _) = resource_from(class);
    let from = if class.family() == Family::Lds { lds_from() } else { from };
    let mut params: Vec<&(dyn ToSql + Sync)> = vec![];
    let w = where_clause(filter, &mut params);
    let cols: Vec<String> = props.iter().map(|p| p.2.clone()).collect();
    let sql = format!("SELECT {} FROM {}{}", cols.join(", "), from, w);
    let rows = c.query(sql.as_str(), &params).await.map_err(e2s)?;
    let mut out = vec![];
    for r in rows {
        let mut o = Obj::new(class);
        for (i, (name, ty, _)) in props.iter().enumerate() {
            let v = match ty {
                SimpleType::Str => r.get::<_, Option<String>>(i).map(V::Str).unwrap_or(V::Null),
                SimpleType::Int => r.get::<_, Option<i32>>(i).map(V::Int).unwrap_or(V::Null),
                SimpleType::Bool => r.get::<_, Option<bool>>(i).map(V::Bool).unwrap_or(V::Null),
                SimpleType::Dbl => r.get::<_, Option<f64>>(i).map(V::Dbl).unwrap_or(V::Null),
            };
            if *name == "id" {
                o.id = match v {
                    V::Int(i) => Some(i),
                    _ => None,
                };
            } else {
                // primitives keep their default when the column is NULL
                let v = if v == V::Null { class.default_value(name) } else { v };
                o.f.insert(name, v);
            }
        }
        out.push(o);
    }
    Ok(out)
}
