/// Hibernate table generator on `hibernate_sequences` (row `default`): runs
/// in its own transaction, so an allocated id stays consumed.
pub async fn next_id<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C) -> DbResult<i32> {
    let row = c
        .query_opt(
            "UPDATE hibernate_sequences SET next_val = next_val + 1 WHERE sequence_name = 'default' RETURNING next_val",
            &[],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(e2s)?;
    if let Some(r) = row {
        let v: Option<i64> = r.get(0);
        return v.map(|v| v as i32).ok_or_else(|| "next_val is null".to_string());
    }
    let row = c
        .query_one(
            "INSERT INTO hibernate_sequences(sequence_name, next_val) VALUES ('default', 1) \
             ON CONFLICT (sequence_name) DO UPDATE SET next_val = hibernate_sequences.next_val + 1 RETURNING next_val",
            &[],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(e2s)?;
    let v: Option<i64> = row.get(0);
    v.map(|v| v as i32).ok_or_else(|| "next_val is null".to_string())
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum SaveMode {
    /// new entity: INSERT
    Insert,
    /// detached entity reattached by cascade: full UPDATE incl. collections
    Reattach,
    /// persistent (loaded) root: UPDATE, only the given collections rewritten
    Persistent,
}

/// One entity write, in execution order.
struct Write {
    obj: Obj,
    mode: SaveMode,
    /// for Persistent: names of collection properties to rewrite
    touched: Option<HashSet<&'static str>>,
}

/// Prepares the writes of a save (root + cascades) like Hibernate's
/// saveOrUpdate + flush: allocates ids in pre-order (through `idc`, outside
/// the main transaction) and detects session conflicts.
pub struct SavePlan {
    writes: Vec<Write>,
}

pub struct Planner<'a, C: GenericClient + Sync> {
    idc: &'a C,
    session: HashSet<(Family, i32)>,
}

impl<'a, C: GenericClient + Sync> Planner<'a, C> {
    pub fn new(idc: &'a C, session: HashSet<(Family, i32)>) -> Self {
        Planner { idc, session }
    }

    /// Plans the save of `root`. For `Persistent`, only the properties in
    /// `touched` were changed by the request. Ids allocated so far stay
    /// consumed when an error is returned.
    pub async fn plan(&mut self, root: &mut Obj, mode: SaveMode, touched: Option<HashSet<&'static str>>) -> DbResult<SavePlan> {
        let mut writes = vec![];
        if mode == SaveMode::Insert {
            let id = next_id(self.idc).await?;
            root.id = Some(id);
            self.session.insert((root.class.family(), id));
        }
        self.cascade(root, touched.as_ref(), &mut writes).await?;
        // transient references (non-cascaded associations without id)
        check_transient(root, touched.as_ref())?;
        for w in &writes {
            check_transient(&w.obj, None)?;
        }
        writes.push(Write { obj: root.clone(), mode, touched });
        Ok(SavePlan { writes })
    }

    fn cascade<'b>(
        &'b mut self,
        o: &'b mut Obj,
        only: Option<&'b HashSet<&'static str>>,
        writes: &'b mut Vec<Write>,
    ) -> BoxFut<'b, DbResult<()>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let class = o.class;
            for f in class.fields() {
                if let Some(only) = only {
                    if !only.contains(f.name) {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if let Kind::ToOne { cascade: true, .. } = f.kind {
                    if let Some(V::Obj(child)) = o.f.get_mut(f.name) {
                        let fam = child.class.family();
                        let mode = match child.id {
                            None => {
                                let id = next_id(self.idc).await?;
                                child.id = Some(id);
                                self.session.insert((fam, id));
                                SaveMode::Insert
                            }
                            Some(id) => {
                                if self.session.contains(&(fam, id)) {
                                    return Err(format!(
                                        "NonUniqueObjectException: a different object with the identifier value [{}] was already associated with the session",
                                        id
                                    ));
                                }
                                self.session.insert((fam, id));
                                SaveMode::Reattach
                            }
                        };
                        self.cascade(child, None, writes).await?;
                        writes.push(Write { obj: (**child).clone(), mode, touched: None });
                    }
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        })
    }
}

fn check_transient(o: &Obj, only: Option<&HashSet<&'static str>>) -> DbResult<()> {
    for f in o.class.fields() {
        if let Some(only) = only {
            if !only.contains(f.name) {
                continue;
            }
        }
        match f.kind {
            Kind::ToOne { cascade: false, .. } => {
                if let V::Obj(c) = o.get(f.name) {
                    if c.id.is_none() {
                        return Err("TransientObjectException".into());
                    }
                }
            }
            Kind::EntSet { .. } => {
                if let V::List(items) = o.get(f.name) {
                    for i in items {
                        if let V::Obj(c) = i {
                            if c.id.is_none() {
                                return Err("TransientObjectException".into());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn column_values(o: &Obj, table: &str) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<Box<dyn ToSql + Sync + Send>>) {
    let mut cols = vec![];
    let mut vals: Vec<Box<dyn ToSql + Sync + Send>> = vec![];
    for f in o.class.fields() {
        if f.table != table {
            continue;
        }
        let v = o.get(f.name);
        match f.kind {
            Kind::Str(c) => {
                cols.push(c.to_string());
                vals.push(Box::new(match v {
                    V::Str(s) => Some(s.clone()),
                    _ => None,
                }));
            }
            Kind::Locale(c) => {
                cols.push(c.to_string());
                vals.push(Box::new(match v {
                    V::Locale(s) => Some(s.clone()),
                    _ => None,
                }));
            }
            Kind::Int(c, _) => {
                cols.push(c.to_string());
                vals.push(Box::new(match v {
                    V::Int(i) => Some(*i),
                    _ => None,
                }));
            }
            Kind::Bool(c, _) => {
                cols.push(c.to_string());
                vals.push(Box::new(match v {
                    V::Bool(b) => Some(*b),
                    _ => None,
                }));
            }
            Kind::Dbl(c) => {
                cols.push(c.to_string());
                vals.push(Box::new(match v {
                    V::Dbl(d) => Some(*d),
                    _ => None,
                }));
            }
            Kind::Date(c) => {
                cols.push(c.to_string());
                vals.push(Box::new(match v {
                    V::Date(d) => Some(*d),
                    _ => None,
                }));
            }
            Kind::Point(x, y) => {
                cols.push(x.to_string());
                cols.push(y.to_string());
                let (px, py) = match v {
                    V::Point(a, b) => (Some(*a), Some(*b)),
                    _ => (None, None),
                };
                vals.push(Box::new(px));
                vals.push(Box::new(py));
            }
            Kind::ToOne { col, .. } => {
                cols.push(col.to_string());
                vals.push(Box::new(match v {
                    V::Obj(c) => c.id,
                    _ => None,
                }));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    (cols, vals)
}

async fn exec<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, sql: &str, vals: &[Box<dyn ToSql + Sync + Send>]) -> DbResult<u64> {
    let refs: Vec<&(dyn ToSql + Sync)> = vals.iter().map(|b| b.as_ref() as &(dyn ToSql + Sync)).collect();
    c.execute(sql, &refs).await.map_err(e2s)
}

async fn write_entity<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, w: &Write, now: NaiveDateTime) -> DbResult<()> {
    let o = &w.obj;
    let id = o.id.ok_or("entity without id")?;
    let tables = o.class.tables();
    for (ti, table) in tables.iter().enumerate() {
        let (mut cols, mut vals) = column_values(o, table);
        match w.mode {
            SaveMode::Insert => {
                if ti == 0 {
                    cols.push("created".into());
                    vals.push(Box::new(now));
                    cols.push("modified".into());
                    vals.push(Box::new(now));
                }
                cols.push("id".into());
                vals.push(Box::new(id));
                let ph: Vec<String> = (1..=vals.len()).map(|i| format!("${}", i)).collect();
                let sql = format!("INSERT INTO {} ({}) VALUES ({})", table, cols.join(", "), ph.join(", "));
                exec(c, &sql, &vals).await?;
            }
            SaveMode::Reattach | SaveMode::Persistent => {
                if ti == 0 {
                    cols.push("modified".into());
                    vals.push(Box::new(now));
                }
                if cols.is_empty() {
                    // table without own columns: Hibernate does not touch it,
                    // but the row must exist for the entity type
                    let n = c
                        .execute(format!("SELECT 1 FROM {} WHERE id = $1", table).as_str(), &[&id])
                        .await
                        .map_err(e2s)?;
                    if n != 1 {
                        return Err("StaleStateException".into());
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                let sets: Vec<String> = cols.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, c)| format!("{} = ${}", c, i + 1)).collect();
                vals.push(Box::new(id));
                let sql = format!("UPDATE {} SET {} WHERE id = ${}", table, sets.join(", "), vals.len());
                let n = exec(c, &sql, &vals).await?;
                if n != 1 {
                    return Err("StaleStateException: unexpected row count".into());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // a reattached detached instance carries new (empty) permission maps
    if w.mode == SaveMode::Reattach {
        c.execute("DELETE FROM userpermissions WHERE entity_id = $1", &[&id]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
        c.execute("DELETE FROM grouppermissions WHERE entity_id = $1", &[&id]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
    }
    // collections
    for f in o.class.fields() {
        let rewrite = match w.mode {
            SaveMode::Insert => false,
            SaveMode::Reattach => true,
            SaveMode::Persistent => w.touched.as_ref().map(|t| t.contains(f.name)).unwrap_or(false),
        };
        let (table, owner) = match collection_table(&f.kind) {
            Some(x) => x,
            None => continue,
        };
        if rewrite {
            c.execute(format!("DELETE FROM {} WHERE {} = $1", table, owner).as_str(), &[&id])
                .await
                .map_err(e2s)?;
        }
        if w.mode == SaveMode::Insert || rewrite {
            insert_collection(c, &f.kind, id, o.get(f.name)).await?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn collection_table(k: &Kind) -> Option<(&'static str, &'static str)> {
    match *k {
        Kind::EntSet { table, owner, .. } => Some((table, owner)),
        Kind::GroupRefs { table, owner, .. } => Some((table, owner)),
        Kind::StrBag { table, owner, .. } => Some((table, owner)),
        Kind::DblList { table, owner, .. } => Some((table, owner)),
        Kind::XyzRes => Some(("xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution", "xyzlayerdatasrc_id")),
        Kind::Props => Some(("layerappearances_properties", "appearance_id")),
        _ => None,
    }
}

async fn insert_collection<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, k: &Kind, id: i32, v: &V) -> DbResult<()> {
    match (k, v) {
        (Kind::EntSet { table, owner, elem, .. }, V::List(items)) => {
            for i in items {
                if let V::Obj(o) = i {
                    let eid = o.id.ok_or("TransientObjectException")?;
                    c.execute(
                        format!("INSERT INTO {} ({}, {}) VALUES ($1, $2)", table, owner, elem).as_str(),
                        &[&id, &eid],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                }
            }
        }
        (Kind::GroupRefs { table, owner, elem }, V::List(items)) => {
            for i in items {
                if let V::Ref(gid) = i {
                    c.execute(
                        format!("INSERT INTO {} ({}, {}) VALUES ($1, $2)", table, owner, elem).as_str(),
                        &[&id, gid],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                }
            }
        }
        (Kind::StrBag { table, owner, col }, V::List(items)) => {
            for i in items {
                if let V::Str(s) = i {
                    c.execute(
                        format!("INSERT INTO {} ({}, {}) VALUES ($1, $2)", table, owner, col).as_str(),
                        &[&id, s],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                }
            }
        }
        (Kind::DblList { table, owner, col, idx }, V::List(items)) => {
            for (n, i) in items.iter().enumerate() {
                if let V::Dbl(d) = i {
                    let n = n as i32;
                    c.execute(
                        format!("INSERT INTO {} ({}, {}, {}) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)", table, owner, col, idx).as_str(),
                        &[&id, d, &n],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                }
            }
        }
        (Kind::XyzRes, V::List(items)) => {
            for (n, i) in items.iter().enumerate() {
                if let V::Point(x, y) = i {
                    let n = n as i32;
                    let bytes = java_serialized_point(*x, *y);
                    c.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution (xyzlayerdatasrc_id, resolution, idx) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)",
                        &[&id, &bytes, &n],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                }
            }
        }
        (Kind::Props, V::Props(items)) => {
            for (key, pv) in items {
                if let Some(t) = &pv.text {
                    c.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO layerappearances_properties (appearance_id, value, property) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)",
                        &[&id, t, key],
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
                }
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    Ok(())
}

impl SavePlan {
    pub async fn execute<C: GenericClient + Sync>(&self, c: &C, now: NaiveDateTime) -> DbResult<()> {
        for w in &self.writes {
            write_entity(c, w, now).await?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Deletes an entity (and what Hibernate cascades a delete to).
pub fn delete_entity<'a, C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &'a C, o: &'a Obj) -> BoxFut<'a, DbResult<()>> {
    Box::pin(async move {
        let id = o.id.ok_or("no id")?;
        // collection rows first
        c.execute("DELETE FROM userpermissions WHERE entity_id = $1", &[&id]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
        c.execute("DELETE FROM grouppermissions WHERE entity_id = $1", &[&id]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
        for f in o.class.fields() {
            if let Some((table, owner)) = collection_table(&f.kind) {
                c.execute(format!("DELETE FROM {} WHERE {} = $1", table, owner).as_str(), &[&id])
                    .await
                    .map_err(e2s)?;
            }
        }
        // tables from leaf to root
        for t in o.class.tables().iter().rev() {
            c.execute(format!("DELETE FROM {} WHERE id = $1", t).as_str(), &[&id]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
        }
        // CascadeType.ALL associations (WMTS tile grid)
        if o.class == Class::Wmts {
            if let V::Obj(tg) = o.get("tileGrid") {
                delete_entity(c, tg).await?;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    })
}

        .query("SELECT DISTINCT map_id FROM maps_layers WHERE layer_id = $1", &[&layer_id])

    Ok(rows.iter().map(|r| r.get(0)).collect())
}

pub async fn remove_layer_from_map<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, map_id: i32, layer_id: i32) -> DbResult<()> {
    let rows = c
        .query("SELECT layer_id, idx FROM maps_layers WHERE map_id = $1 ORDER BY idx", &[&map_id])
        .await
        .map_err(e2s)?;
    let mut layers: Vec<i32> = rows.iter().map(|r| r.get(0)).collect();
    if let Some(pos) = layers.iter().position(|l| *l == layer_id) {
        layers.remove(pos);
    }
    c.execute("DELETE FROM maps_layers WHERE map_id = $1", &[&map_id]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
    for (i, l) in layers.iter().enumerate() {
        let i = i as i32;
        c.execute("INSERT INTO maps_layers (map_id, layer_id, idx) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)", &[&map_id, l, &i])
            .await
            .map_err(e2s)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

const GROUP_CRITERIA_SQL: &str = "select this_.id, this_.created, this_.modified, this_.name, this_.owner_id, grouppermi2_.entity_id, permission3_.id, grouppermi2_.grouppermissions_key, permission3_.id, permission3_.created, permission3_.modified, userpermis4_.entity_id, permission5_.id, userpermis4_.userpermissions_key, permission5_.id, permission5_.created, permission5_.modified, permission6_.permissioncollections_id, permission6_.permissions, members7_.usergroup_id, user8_.id, user8_.id, user8_1_.created, user8_1_.modified, user8_1_.birthday, user8_1_.email, user8_1_.firstname, user8_1_.language, user8_1_.lastname, user8_.accountname, user8_.active, user8_.password, roles9_.user_id, role10_.id, role10_.id, role10_.created, role10_.modified, role10_.description, role10_.name, user11_.id, user11_1_.created, user11_1_.modified, user11_1_.birthday, user11_1_.email, user11_1_.firstname, user11_1_.language, user11_1_.lastname, user11_.accountname, user11_.active, user11_.password from usergroups this_ left outer join grouppermissions grouppermi2_ on this_.id=grouppermi2_.entity_id left outer join permissioncollections permission3_ on grouppermi2_.grouppermissions_id=permission3_.id left outer join userpermissions userpermis4_ on permission3_.id=userpermis4_.entity_id left outer join permissioncollections permission5_ on userpermis4_.userpermissions_id=permission5_.id left outer join permissioncollections_permissions permission6_ on permission5_.id=permission6_.permissioncollections_id left outer join user_usergroup members7_ on this_.id=members7_.usergroup_id left outer join users user8_ on members7_.user_id=user8_.id left outer join persons user8_1_ on user8_.id=user8_1_.id left outer join users_roles roles9_ on user8_.id=roles9_.user_id left outer join roles role10_ on roles9_.role_id=role10_.id left outer join users user11_ on this_.owner_id=user11_.id left outer join persons user11_1_ on user11_.id=user11_1_.id";

pub async fn group_criteria_fails<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, filter: &Filter) -> DbResult<bool> {
    let mut params: Vec<&(dyn ToSql + Sync)> = vec![];
    let mut ands = vec![];
    for (col, vals) in filter {
        let col = col.replacen("usergroups.", "this_.", 1);
        let mut ors = vec![];
        for v in vals {
            params.push(v.as_sql());
            ors.push(format!("{}=${}", col, params.len()));
        }
        ands.push(format!("({})", ors.join(" or ")));
    }
    let sql = if ands.is_empty() {
        GROUP_CRITERIA_SQL.to_string()
    } else {
        format!("{} where ({})", GROUP_CRITERIA_SQL, ands.join(" and "))
    };
    let rows = c.query(sql.as_str(), &params).await.map_err(e2s)?;
    let mut hydrating: Vec<i32> = vec![];
    let mut loaded: HashSet<i32> = HashSet::new();
    let mut keys: HashMap<i32, HashSet<i32>> = HashMap::new();
    for r in rows {
        let root: i32 = r.get(0);
        let key: Option<i32> = r.get(7);
        if loaded.contains(&root) {
            continue;
        }
        if !hydrating.contains(&root) {
            hydrating.push(root);
        }
        if let Some(k) = key {
            keys.entry(root).or_default().insert(k);
            if !hydrating.contains(&k) && !loaded.contains(&k) {
                // nested immediate load of the key group (and its keys)
                let mut stack = vec![k];
                while let Some(g) = stack.pop() {
                    if !loaded.insert(g) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let ks = c
                        .query("SELECT grouppermissions_key FROM grouppermissions WHERE entity_id = $1", &[&g])
                        .await
                        .map_err(e2s)?;
                    for kr in ks {
                        let kk: i32 = kr.get(0);
                        if !loaded.contains(&kk) && !hydrating.contains(&kk) {
                            stack.push(kk);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(hydrating
        .iter()
        .any(|r| keys.get(r).map(|ks| ks.iter().any(|k| hydrating.contains(k))).unwrap_or(false)))
}

/// source id -> url bag, for the given root ids (layers or data sources).
pub async fn wmts_url_bags<C: GenericClient + Sync>(c: &C, ctx: BagContext, roots: &[i32]) -> DbResult<HashMap<i32, Vec<String>>> {
    let (from, root, source, urls) = match ctx {
        BagContext::LdsCriteria => (LDS_CRITERIA_FROM, "this_", "this_", "urls11_"),
        BagContext::LdsGet => (LDS_GET_FROM, "layerdatas0_", "layerdatas0_", "urls18_"),
        BagContext::LayerCriteria => (LAYER_CRITERIA_FROM, "this_", "layerdatas9_", "urls14_"),
        BagContext::LayerGet => (LAYER_GET_FROM, "layer0_", "layerdatas15_", "urls21_"),
    };
    let sql = format!(
        "select {}.id, {}.urls {} where {}.id = ANY($1) and {}.urls is not null",
        source, urls, from, root, urls
    );
    let roots: Vec<i32> = roots.to_vec();
    let rows = c.query(sql.as_str(), &[&roots]).await.map_err(e2s)?;
    let mut out: HashMap<i32, Vec<String>> = HashMap::new();
    for r in rows {
        out.entry(r.get(0)).or_default().push(r.get(1));
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Replaces the urls of every WMTS source inside `o` by its bag.
pub fn apply_url_bags(o: &mut Obj, bags: &HashMap<i32, Vec<String>>) {
    if o.class == Class::Wmts {
        if let Some(id) = o.id {
            let bag = bags.get(&id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            o.f.insert("urls", V::List(bag.into_iter().map(V::Str).collect()));
        }
    }
    if let Some(V::Obj(s)) = o.f.get_mut("source") {
        apply_url_bags(s, bags);
    }
}

//! End-to-end test: starts the service binary on the database given by
//! `DATABASE_URL`, loads `tests/data/seed.sql` and checks the REST API.
//!
//! It only runs when that database has `schema.sql` loaded and holds no data
//! (it is emptied again at the end); otherwise it is skipped.

use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};
use std::process::{Child, Command, Stdio};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

const SEED: &str = include_str!("data/seed.sql");
const SCHEMA: &str = include_str!("data/schema.sql");
const EMPTY: &str = "DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN \
  FOR r IN SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' LOOP \
    EXECUTE 'TRUNCATE TABLE public.' || quote_ident(r.tablename) || ' CASCADE'; \
  END LOOP; END $$;";

struct Server(Child);
impl Drop for Server {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.0.kill();
        let _ = self.0.wait();
    }
}

struct Resp {
    status: u16,
    body: String,
}

impl Resp {
    fn json(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        serde_json::from_str(&self.body).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null)
    }
}

fn request(port: u16, method: &str, path: &str, user: Option<(&str, &str)>, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {
    use base64::Engine;
    let mut s = TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", port)).expect("connect");
    s.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(30))).unwrap();
    let mut req = format!("{} {} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n", method, path);
    if let Some((u, p)) = user {
        let t = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(format!("{}:{}", u, p));
        req.push_str(&format!("Authorization: Basic {}\r\n", t));
    }
    let b = body.unwrap_or("");
    if body.is_some() {
        req.push_str("Content-Type: application/json\r\n");
    }
    req.push_str(&format!("Content-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{}", b.len(), b));
    s.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();
    let mut raw = Vec::new();
    s.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();
    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw).to_string();
    let status: u16 = text.split(' ').nth(1).and_then(|c| c.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    let (head, body) = text.split_once("\r\n\r\n").unwrap_or((&text, ""));
    let body = if head.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("transfer-encoding: chunked") {
        dechunk(body)
    } else {
        body.to_string()
    };
    Resp { status, body }
}

fn dechunk(mut s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    loop {
        let (len, rest) = match s.split_once("\r\n") {
            Some(x) => x,
            None => break,
        };
        let n = usize::from_str_radix(len.trim(), 16).unwrap_or(0);
        if n == 0 {
            break;
        }
        out.push_str(&rest[..n]);
        s = &rest[n + 2..];
    }
    out
}

fn ids(v: &serde_json::Value) -> Vec<i64> {
    let mut out: Vec<i64> = v.as_array().map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(|o| o["id"].as_i64()).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    out.sort();
    out
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn rest_api_against_database() {
    let url = match std::env::var("DATABASE_URL") {
        Ok(u) => u,
        Err(_) => {
            eprintln!("DATABASE_URL not set: skipping");
            return;
        }
    };
    let (client, conn) = match tokio_postgres::connect(&url, tokio_postgres::NoTls).await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("database not reachable ({}): skipping", e);
            return;
        }
    };
    tokio::spawn(conn);
    let rows = client
        .query_one(
            "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM persons) + (SELECT count(*) FROM roles) + (SELECT count(*) FROM hibernate_sequences)",
            &[],
        )
        .await
        .map(|r| r.get::<_, i64>(0));
    if matches!(rows, Ok(0)) {
        // the given (empty) database is used and emptied again afterwards
        run(&url, client).await;
        return;
    }
    // never touch a database holding data: use a temporary one on the same server
    let name = format!("shogun_rest_test_{}", std::process::id());
    if let Err(e) = client.batch_execute(&format!("CREATE DATABASE {}", name)).await {
        eprintln!("database not empty and no temporary database possible ({}): skipping", e);
        return;
    }
    let mut cfg: tokio_postgres::Config = url.parse().expect("DATABASE_URL");
    cfg.dbname(&name);
    let (tmp, tconn) = cfg.connect(tokio_postgres::NoTls).await.expect("connect temporary database");
    let th = tokio::spawn(tconn);
    let tmp_url = temp_url(&url, &name);
    let result = tokio::spawn(async move {
        // schema.sql without psql meta-commands (lines starting with a backslash)
        let schema: String = SCHEMA.lines().filter(|l| !l.starts_with('\\')).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n");
        tmp.batch_execute(&schema).await.expect("load schema");
        run(&tmp_url, tmp).await
    })
    .await;
    th.abort();
    let _ = client.batch_execute(&format!("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS {} WITH (FORCE)", name)).await;
    if let Err(e) = result {
        if e.is_panic() {
            std::panic::resume_unwind(e.into_panic());
        }
        panic!("{}", e);
    }
}

/// `url` with the database name replaced.
fn temp_url(url: &str, db: &str) -> String {
    let (base, query) = match url.split_once('?') {
        Some((b, q)) => (b, format!("?{}", q)),
        None => (url, String::new()),
    };
    let scheme_end = base.find("://").map(|i| i + 3).unwrap_or(0);
    match base[scheme_end..].find('/') {
        Some(i) => format!("{}/{}{}", &base[..scheme_end + i], db, query),
        None => format!("{}/{}{}", base, db, query),
    }
}

async fn run(url: &str, client: tokio_postgres::Client) {
    let url = url.to_string();
    client.batch_execute(SEED).await.expect("seed");

    let port = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let _server = Server(
        Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_shogun-rest"))
            .env("DATABASE_URL", &url)
            .env("PORT", port.to_string())
            .stdout(Stdio::null())
            .stderr(Stdio::null())
            .spawn()
            .expect("start service"),
    );
    let start = Instant::now();
    while TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", port)).is_err() {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(60), "service did not start");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
    }

    let client = std::sync::Arc::new(client);
    let c2 = client.clone();
    let outcome = tokio::spawn(async move { checks(port, &c2).await }).await;
    client.batch_execute(EMPTY).await.expect("empty database again");
    if let Err(e) = outcome {
        if e.is_panic() {
            std::panic::resume_unwind(e.into_panic());
        }
        panic!("{}", e);
    }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Differential test: replays requests against the original (REF) and the
port (PORT), each on its own database reset to the same seed, and compares
status codes, JSON bodies (order-insensitive) and the rows written.

usage: compare.py [case-file.json ...]   (default: built-in cases)
env:   REF=localhost:8081 PORT=localhost:8082 REF_DB=ref PORT_DB=port
"""
import base64, json, os, subprocess, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error

REF = os.environ.get("REF", "localhost:8081")
PORT = os.environ.get("PORT", "localhost:8082")
REF_DB = os.environ.get("REF_DB", "ref")
PORT_DB = os.environ.get("PORT_DB", "port")
SEED = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "data", os.environ.get("DATASET", "seed") + ".sql")

TABLES = """hibernate_sequences roles persons users users_roles usergroups user_usergroup usergroups_roles
layers layerappearances layerappearances_properties layerdatasources imagewmslayerdatasources
tilewmslayerdatasources wfslayerdatasources wmtslayerdatasources wmtslayerdatasources_urls
xyzlayerdatasources xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution tilegrids tilegrid_resolution wmtstilegrids
wmtstilegrids_matrixids extents userpermissions grouppermissions permissioncollections
permissioncollections_permissions maps_layers""".split()


def psql(db, sql):
    return subprocess.run(["psql", "-qAt", "-d", db, "-c", sql], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


def reset(db, extra=None):
    subprocess.run(["psql", "-q", "-d", db, "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-f", SEED],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(os.environ, PGOPTIONS="-c client_min_messages=warning"))
    if extra:
        psql(db, extra)


def dump(db):
    out = {}
    for t in TABLES:
        rows = psql(db, f"select (to_jsonb(t) - 'created' - 'modified')::text from {t} t").splitlines()
        out[t] = sorted(rows)
    return out


def canon(v):
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return sorted((canon(x) for x in v), key=lambda x: json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True))
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return {k: canon(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        return int(v)
    return v


def call(host, user, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    url = f"http://{host}{path}"
    data = None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body, bytes) else body.encode("utf-8"))
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    if user:
        name, pw = (user.split(":", 1) + ["shogun"])[:2] if ":" in user else (user, "shogun")
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Basic " + base64.b64encode(f"{name}:{pw}".encode()).decode())
    if body is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            return r.status, r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")


def parse(text):
    try:
        return canon(json.loads(text))
    except Exception:
        return None


DIRTY = False


def run_case(case, verbose=False):
    user, method, path = case["user"], case["method"], case["path"]
    body = case.get("body")
    if body is not None and not isinstance(body, str):
        body = json.dumps(body)
    global DIRTY
    mutating = method in ("POST", "PUT", "DELETE") or case.get("sql")
    if mutating or DIRTY:
        reset(REF_DB, case.get("sql"))
        reset(PORT_DB, case.get("sql"))
    DIRTY = bool(mutating)
    rs, rb = call(REF, user, method, path, body)
    ps, pb = call(PORT, user, method, path, body)
    problems = []
    if rs != ps:
        problems.append(f"status ref={rs} port={ps}")
    rj, pj = parse(rb), parse(pb)
    if rs < 300 or ps < 300:
        if rj != pj:
            problems.append(f"body differs\n   ref : {rb[:1500]}\n   port: {pb[:1500]}")
    if mutating:
        dr, dp = dump(REF_DB), dump(PORT_DB)
        for t in TABLES:
            if dr[t] != dp[t]:
                a, b = set(dr[t]), set(dp[t])
                problems.append(f"table {t}: only ref {sorted(a - b)[:5]} only port {sorted(b - a)[:5]}")
    label = f"{user} {method} {path} {body or ''}"[:200]
    if problems:
        print("FAIL", label)
        for p in problems:
            print("   ", p)
        return False
    if verbose:
        print("ok  ", label, rs)
    return True


def main():
    files = sys.argv[1:] or [os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "cases.json")]
    cases = []
    for f in files:
        with open(f) as fh:
            cases += json.load(fh)
    reset(REF_DB)
    reset(PORT_DB)
    ok = 0
    for c in cases:
        if run_case(c, verbose=os.environ.get("VERBOSE")):
            ok += 1
    print(f"{ok}/{len(cases)} cases identical")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
